`apps/swarm/src/config.ts`:

```typescript
import {
  asAbsolutePath,
  asAmount,
  asInteger,
  asNear,
  asPositiveInteger,
  completeConfig,
  EnvReader,
  readBuyerSettings,
  readMcpBuyerSettings,
  type BuyerSettings,
  type Env,
  type McpBuyerSettings,
  type Rule,
} from '@quorum-on-near/buyer';
import { scriptedBuyerIds } from './accounts.ts';
import { TGAS } from './chain.ts';

/**
 * The swarm's configuration: the settings it shares with the gateway and the buyers, read from the
 * gateway's own variables and defaults, then those it shares with the MCP server (its buyer, the
 * folder of the key files and the spend file, as the server reads them), then its own (see
 * `.env.example`).
 */
export interface SwarmConfig extends BuyerSettings, McpBuyerSettings {
  /** QUORUM_FUNDING_ACCOUNT: the only source of the token, `funding.<parent>` by default; may be the parent. */
  funding: string;
  /** QUORUM_RELAYER_ACCOUNT: the account the gateway relays payments with, `relay.<parent>` by default. */
  relayer: string;
  /** QUORUM_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT: the simulated seller, `provider.<parent>` by default. */
  provider: string;
  /** QUORUM_POOLS_WASM: the pools contract's wasm file, or null when unset; needed only to deploy it. */
  poolsWasm: string | null;
  /** QUORUM_RELAYER_KEY_COUNT: the full-access keys setup gives the relayer when it creates it. */
  relayerKeyCount: number;
  /** QUORUM_BUYER_NEAR: the NEAR each buyer is topped up to, in yoctoNEAR. */
  buyerNear: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_PROVIDER_NEAR: the NEAR the provider is topped up to, in yoctoNEAR. */
  providerNear: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_FUNDING_NEAR: the NEAR the funding account is topped up to, in yoctoNEAR, unless it is the parent. */
  fundingNear: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_RELAYER_NEAR: the NEAR the relayer is topped up to, in yoctoNEAR. */
  relayerNear: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_POOLS_NEAR: the NEAR the pools account is created with, and topped up to while it holds no code, in yoctoNEAR. */
  poolsNear: bigint;
  /**
   * QUORUM_POOLS_FREE_NEAR: once the pools contract is deployed, the NEAR setup keeps on it beyond
   * what its storage locks (freeBalance), in yoctoNEAR.
   */
  poolsFreeNear: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_BUYER_BUDGET: the token balance each buyer is topped up to, in base units. */
  buyerBudget: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_PROVIDER_BONUS_FUNDS: the token balance the provider is topped up to, in base units. */
  providerBonusFunds: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_COMMIT_MIN_GAS: the gas a payment's `ft_transfer_call` attaches at least, as the gateway offers it. */
  commitMinGas: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_COMMIT_MAX_GAS: the gas a payment's `ft_transfer_call` attaches at most, at least `commitMinGas`. */
  commitMaxGas: bigint;
  /** QUORUM_SCENARIO_DEADLINE_SECONDS: overrides every scenario's deadline; null keeps each scenario's own. */
  deadlineSeconds: number | null;
  /** QUORUM_SWARM_SPREAD_SECONDS: overrides every scenario's arrival spread; null keeps each scenario's own. */
  spreadSeconds: number | null;
  /** QUORUM_REDEEM_INTERVAL_MS: how often a scripted buyer polls its redemption. */
  redeemIntervalMs: number;
}

/** The most gas the gateway attaches to one call, and so the most either commit gas bound may be. */
const MAX_CALL_GAS = 300n * TGAS;
/** The longest delay a Node timer honours: it turns any longer one into 1 ms. */
const MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS = 2_147_483_647;
const DIGITS = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/;

/** Gas as the gateway reads it, so that one value of a shared variable works for both. */
const asGas: Rule<bigint> = {
  expected: `an amount of gas from 1 to ${MAX_CALL_GAS} (300 Tgas, the most the gateway attaches to one call)`,
  parse(raw) {
    const gas = DIGITS.test(raw) ? BigInt(raw) : 0n;
    return gas >= 1n && gas <= MAX_CALL_GAS ? gas : undefined;
  },
};

const asSpreadSeconds = asInteger(
  0,
  Math.floor(MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS / 1000),
  `an integer from 0 to ${Math.floor(MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS / 1000)} (the longest delay a Node timer honours, in seconds)`,
);

const asIntervalMs = asInteger(
  1,
  MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS,
  `an integer from 1 to ${MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS} (the longest delay a Node timer honours)`,
);

/**
 * Reads the configuration from environment variables (see `.env.example`). Collects every problem,
 * the shared variables' first, and throws one ConfigError listing them all.
 */
export function loadSwarmConfig(env: Env): SwarmConfig {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const read = new EnvReader(env, problems);
  const base = readBuyerSettings(env, problems);
  const { parent } = base;
  const mcp = readMcpBuyerSettings(env, problems, parent);
  const funding = read.child('QUORUM_FUNDING_ACCOUNT', 'funding', parent);
  const relayer = read.child('QUORUM_RELAYER_ACCOUNT', 'relay', parent);
  const provider = read.child('QUORUM_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT', 'provider', parent);
  const poolsWasm = read.nullable('QUORUM_POOLS_WASM', asAbsolutePath);
  const relayerKeyCount = read.optional('QUORUM_RELAYER_KEY_COUNT', '4', asPositiveInteger);
  const buyerNear = read.optional('QUORUM_BUYER_NEAR', '0.05', asNear);
  const providerNear = read.optional('QUORUM_PROVIDER_NEAR', '0.5', asNear);
  const fundingNear = read.optional('QUORUM_FUNDING_NEAR', '0.5', asNear);
  const relayerNear = read.optional('QUORUM_RELAYER_NEAR', '3', asNear);
  const poolsNear = read.optional('QUORUM_POOLS_NEAR', '3.5', asNear);
  const poolsFreeNear = read.optional('QUORUM_POOLS_FREE_NEAR', '1', asNear);
  const buyerBudget = read.optional('QUORUM_BUYER_BUDGET', '10000', asAmount);
  const providerBonusFunds = read.optional('QUORUM_PROVIDER_BONUS_FUNDS', '10000', asAmount);
  const commitMinGas = read.optional('QUORUM_COMMIT_MIN_GAS', '50000000000000', asGas);
  const commitMaxGas = read.optional('QUORUM_COMMIT_MAX_GAS', '100000000000000', asGas);
  if (commitMinGas !== undefined && commitMaxGas !== undefined && commitMaxGas < commitMinGas) {
    problems.push(`QUORUM_COMMIT_MAX_GAS must be at least QUORUM_COMMIT_MIN_GAS (${commitMinGas}), got "${commitMaxGas}"`);
  }
  const deadlineSeconds = read.nullable('QUORUM_SCENARIO_DEADLINE_SECONDS', asPositiveInteger);
  const spreadSeconds = read.nullable('QUORUM_SWARM_SPREAD_SECONDS', asSpreadSeconds);
  const redeemIntervalMs = read.optional('QUORUM_REDEEM_INTERVAL_MS', '5000', asIntervalMs);

  if (parent !== undefined) {
    problems.push(
      ...sharedAccounts(parent, [
        ['QUORUM_FUNDING_ACCOUNT', funding],
        ['QUORUM_POOLS_ACCOUNT', base.poolsContract],
        ['QUORUM_RELAYER_ACCOUNT', relayer],
        ['QUORUM_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT', provider],
        ['QUORUM_MCP_ACCOUNT', mcp.mcpAccount],
      ]),
    );
  }

  return completeConfig<SwarmConfig>(
    {
      ...base,
      ...mcp,
      funding,
      relayer,
      provider,
      poolsWasm,
      relayerKeyCount,
      buyerNear,
      providerNear,
      fundingNear,
      relayerNear,
      poolsNear,
      poolsFreeNear,
      buyerBudget,
      providerBonusFunds,
      commitMinGas,
      commitMaxGas,
      deadlineSeconds,
      spreadSeconds,
      redeemIntervalMs,
    },
    problems,
  );
}

/**
 * One problem for each role that names an account already taken: by the parent, by an earlier role
 * or by a scripted buyer. Each account has one role, since setup tops each one up to its own amounts.
 * Only the funding account may be the parent. Roles whose variable has a problem are skipped.
 */
function sharedAccounts(parent: string, roles: Array<[name: string, id: string | undefined]>): string[] {
  const taken = new Map<string, string>(scriptedBuyerIds(parent).map((id) => [id, 'a scripted buyer']));
  const problems: string[] = [];
  for (const [name, id] of roles) {
    if (id === undefined) continue;
    const owner = id === parent && name !== 'QUORUM_FUNDING_ACCOUNT' ? 'QUORUM_PARENT_ACCOUNT' : taken.get(id);
    if (owner !== undefined) problems.push(`${name} must name an account of its own, but ${JSON.stringify(id)} is also ${owner}`);
    else taken.set(id, name);
  }
  return problems;
}
```

```bash
# Swarm configuration. Copy to .env and fill in the one required value (left empty here).
# Every other line shows its default, which applies when the variable is unset. Variables already set
# in the environment take precedence over this file.

# --- Shared with the gateway and the MCP server: give each the same value in every app. ---

# NEAR network, in CAIP-2 form: near:testnet, or near:sandbox for a local test chain. No other is accepted.
QUORUM_NETWORK=near:testnet
# NEAR RPC endpoint. Every swarm command but env and help stops unless it serves that chain (testnet,
# or any non-public chain).
QUORUM_RPC_URL=https://test.rpc.fastnear.com
# Where the gateway is reached. Its host is the recipient redemption proofs name, so write it exactly
# as the gateway's own QUORUM_GATEWAY_URL.
QUORUM_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8402
# Required. The parent account: every other account is created under it, and it pays their NEAR.
QUORUM_PARENT_ACCOUNT=
# Token the pools contract is initialised with (Circle's USDC on testnet).
QUORUM_TOKEN_ACCOUNT=3e2210e1184b45b64c8a434c0a7e7b23cc04ea7eb7a6c3c32520d03d4afcb8af
# Pools contract account. Unset means pools.<parent>.
#QUORUM_POOLS_ACCOUNT=
# Block time used to turn an offer's timeout into blocks, in milliseconds; the gateway's value.
QUORUM_BLOCK_TIME_MS=1000

# --- Shared with the gateway: give it the same value. ---

# Account that relays payments and pays their gas. Unset means relay.<parent>.
#QUORUM_RELAYER_ACCOUNT=
# The simulated seller, which opens the pools. Unset means provider.<parent>.
#QUORUM_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT=
# Least gas a payment's ft_transfer_call may attach, at most 300000000000000 (300 Tgas). The final
# check fails a commit that burns more.
QUORUM_COMMIT_MIN_GAS=50000000000000
# Most gas a payment's ft_transfer_call may attach; from the minimum to 300000000000000 (300 Tgas).
QUORUM_COMMIT_MAX_GAS=100000000000000

# --- Shared with the MCP server: give it the same value. ---

# The longest a payment a buyer signs stays valid, in seconds, from 30 to 3600. A buyer signs an
# expiry of the offer's timeout or this, whichever is shorter. Not the gateway's
# QUORUM_MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
QUORUM_BUYER_MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=120

# Absolute path of the folder that holds the key files, in near-cli's layout
# (<folder>/testnet/<account>.json). Unset means ~/.near-credentials.
#QUORUM_CREDENTIALS_DIR=
# The buyer the MCP server acts for. Unset means buyer-llm.<parent>.
#QUORUM_MCP_ACCOUNT=
# Absolute path of the MCP server's running spend total. Setup clears it on every run whose token
# top-ups go through, also when none was needed; a run stopped before then, by a token shortfall for
# one, leaves it. Unset means data/mcp-spend.json at the root of the repository.
#QUORUM_MCP_SPEND_FILE=

# --- The swarm's own. ---

# The only source of the token: setup tops the buyers and the provider up from it, reset returns
# their surpluses to it. Any account with a key file will do, the parent included. Unset means
# funding.<parent>.
#QUORUM_FUNDING_ACCOUNT=
# Absolute path of the pools contract's wasm file. Needed only when setup has to deploy the contract.
#QUORUM_POOLS_WASM=
# Full-access keys setup gives the relayer account when it creates it.
QUORUM_RELAYER_KEY_COUNT=4
# NEAR balances setup tops each account up to, as decimal numbers of NEAR.
QUORUM_BUYER_NEAR=0.05
QUORUM_PROVIDER_NEAR=0.5
# Not used when the funding account is the parent.
QUORUM_FUNDING_NEAR=0.5
QUORUM_RELAYER_NEAR=3
# The pools account's balance at creation, and its target until the contract is deployed on it.
QUORUM_POOLS_NEAR=3.5
# Once the contract is deployed, the NEAR setup keeps on it beyond what its storage locks. The records
# it keeps for each pool and buyer grow and are never freed, so setup tops it up back to this once
# less than 90% of it is free.
QUORUM_POOLS_FREE_NEAR=1
# Token balance setup tops each buyer up to, and reset brings it back to, in base units.
QUORUM_BUYER_BUDGET=10000
# Token balance setup tops the provider up to, and reset brings it back to, in base units.
QUORUM_PROVIDER_BONUS_FUNDS=10000
# Deadline of every scenario's pool, in seconds. Unset keeps each scenario's own.
#QUORUM_SCENARIO_DEADLINE_SECONDS=
# Scripted buyers arrive after a random delay below this many seconds, from 0 to 2147483. Unset keeps
# each scenario's own.
#QUORUM_SWARM_SPREAD_SECONDS=
# How often each scripted buyer polls its redemption, in milliseconds, from 1 to 2147483647.
QUORUM_REDEEM_INTERVAL_MS=5000
```

### Task 7: The chain over RPC, and the fake chain

`RpcSwarmChain` implements `SwarmChain` over near-api-js's JSON-RPC provider.
`createRpcSwarmChain(settings)` gives it two providers on `QUORUM_RPC_URL`: its reads keep
near-api-js's default retries, since they change nothing; its writes, with the nonce and block reads
near-api-js makes to build them, and its wait for a transaction to be final go through a provider
built with `retries: 1`, so that each signed transaction is posted once and each wait asked once.
Views are read at final finality, at the height of a final block (`block_id`; a height that is not
a safe integer is refused with a `RangeError` before anything is read, since near-api-js sends it
as a JSON number), or, for `list_pools` when asked, at optimistic finality. `account` is null for
an account that does not exist, and holds code when its code hash is not 32 zero bytes.
`txOutcome` asks first without waiting (`wait_until: NONE`): null at once for a transaction the RPC
does not know, one older than its history included. A FINAL transaction is converted at once; any
other is waited for once at FINAL, and is null if the RPC ends that wait unanswered (an HTTP 408 or
a `TIMEOUT_ERROR`).

Each write is one transaction, signed through one near-api-js `Account` per key, which caches the
key's nonce, and sent only once that key's previous write has settled, so that a key never has two
transactions in flight. It waits until the transaction is FINAL, then checks every receipt:
near-api-js's own check reads only the transaction's final status, which reports success when a
later receipt, such as a receiver's callback, failed. Each batched call attaches 20 Tgas, the pools
contract's `new` in its deploy transaction 30 Tgas, and `ft_transfer_call` 100 Tgas; each
`ft_transfer` and `ft_transfer_call` attaches 1 yoctoNEAR, and each `storage_deposit` the
registration deposit. Every write but `ftTransferCall` goes through near-api-js's
`signAndSendTransaction`, which, after an `InvalidNonce` answer, signs the transaction again with a
nonce read afresh. `ftTransferCall`, the provider's bonus transfer (Task 9), is signed first, with a
nonce read for it alone, so that its hash is known, and sent once: `InvalidNonce` rejects
`NonceTakenError`, and a timeout, an HTTP 5xx or a request that could not be made rejects
`OutcomeUnknownError`, both naming the transaction. The call's own status is
`ft_resolve_transfer`'s, so a failure there means that nothing was transferred
(`TransactionFailedError`); a failure in the receiver's receipts is returned, with `used`, the
amount the token kept.

`test/fake-chain.ts` is an in-memory `SwarmChain` for the unit tests of Tasks 8 to 12 and 16, with
the constants and builders they share: `PARENT` is `parent.testnet`, and `testConfig` points the key
files and the spend file into a folder that cannot exist, so that only a test that passes its own
paths can touch a file. Its writes follow the token's and the pools contract's rules that setup, the
provider and the check rely on (its class comment lists them), so that a command run twice sees its
first run's effects; it burns no gas and never derives a pool's status from block time. It is a test
helper, written with the implementation because its own tests, `test/fake-chain.test.ts`, import
it. `test/rpc-chain.test.ts` drives `RpcSwarmChain` through a stub `Provider`, and
`createRpcSwarmChain` through a stub `fetch`. The class comment of `RpcSwarmChain` mentions the
sandbox suite's in-process reset, which Tasks 15 and 16 build.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/swarm/src/rpc-chain.ts`, `apps/swarm/test/fake-chain.ts` (a test helper)
- Test: `apps/swarm/test/fake-chain.test.ts`, `apps/swarm/test/rpc-chain.test.ts`

`apps/swarm/test/fake-chain.test.ts`:

```typescript
import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { parseEventLog, poolsEvents, type PoolView, type TxOutcome } from '@quorum-on-near/protocol';
import { KeyPair } from 'near-api-js';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { TransactionFailedError, type AccountKey } from '../src/chain.ts';
import {
  FakeChain,
  NEAR,
  NOW_MS,
  PARENT,
  POOLS,
  poolView,
  PROVIDER,
  REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT,
  testConfig,
  TOKEN,
} from './fake-chain.ts';

const BUYER = `buyer-01.${PARENT}`;
const FUNDING = `funding.${PARENT}`;
const TERMS = '8×GPU × 24 h; 1 seat = 1 GPU-hour; prices at 1/10,000 scale';

/** A fake with the parent holding 10 NEAR and a key, and that key. */
function setup(): { chain: FakeChain; parent: AccountKey } {
  const chain = new FakeChain();
  const parent = chain.addSigner(PARENT, 10n * NEAR);
  return { chain, parent };
}

/** The `open` message of a pool, as the provider sends it. */
function openMsg(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    open: { seat_price: '180', target: 192, deadline_ms: NOW_MS + 600_000, max_seats_per_buyer: 24, terms: TERMS, ...overrides },
  });
}

/** A fake whose provider is registered with `tokens` and whose pools contract is deployed and registered. */
function withPools(tokens = 10_000n): { chain: FakeChain; provider: AccountKey } {
  const chain = new FakeChain();
  const provider = chain.addSigner(PROVIDER, NEAR);
  chain.addAccount(POOLS, { balance: 3n * NEAR, hasCode: true });
  chain.register(PROVIDER, tokens);
  chain.register(POOLS);
  return { chain, provider };
}

describe('testConfig', () => {
  it('names the fake chain’s accounts', () => {
    const config = testConfig();
    expect([config.parent, config.poolsContract, config.token, config.provider]).toEqual([PARENT, POOLS, TOKEN, PROVIDER]);
  });

  it('points its key and spend files where nothing can be read or written', async () => {
    const { credentialsDir, spendFile } = testConfig();
    for (const path of [credentialsDir, join(spendFile, '..')]) {
      await expect(mkdir(path, { recursive: true })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: expect.stringMatching(/^(ENOTDIR|EEXIST)$/) });
    }
  });

  it('takes overrides', () => {
    expect(testConfig({ buyerBudget: 5n }).buyerBudget).toBe(5n);
  });
});

describe('FakeChain reads', () => {
  it('reports the chain id it is given', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    expect(await chain.chainId()).toBe('testnet');
    chain.nodeChainId = 'sandbox-1';
    expect(await chain.chainId()).toBe('sandbox-1');
  });

  it('gives an account’s balance, code flag and storage, and null for a missing one', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    chain.addAccount(POOLS, { balance: 7n, hasCode: true, storageUsage: 204_022n });
    chain.addAccount(BUYER);
    expect(await chain.account(POOLS)).toEqual({ balance: 7n, hasCode: true, storageUsage: 204_022n });
    expect(await chain.account(BUYER)).toEqual({ balance: 0n, hasCode: false, storageUsage: 0n });
    expect(await chain.account('missing.testnet')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('gives the token of a deployed pools contract, and fails without a contract', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    await expect(chain.getToken()).rejects.toThrow(`${POOLS} holds no contract`);
    chain.addAccount(POOLS, { hasCode: true });
    expect(await chain.getToken()).toBe(TOKEN);
    chain.poolsToken = 'other.testnet';
    expect(await chain.getToken()).toBe('other.testnet');
  });

  it('reads registrations and token balances', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    chain.register(BUYER, 42n);
    expect(await chain.registrationDeposit()).toBe(REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT);
    expect([await chain.isRegistered(BUYER), await chain.ftBalanceOf(BUYER)]).toEqual([true, 42n]);
    expect([await chain.isRegistered(FUNDING), await chain.ftBalanceOf(FUNDING)]).toEqual([false, 0n]);
  });

  it('pages pools and seats as the contract does, at most 100 per call', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    for (let id = 0; id < 105; id += 1) chain.setPool(poolView({ id }));
    const seats = Array.from({ length: 103 }, (_, i) => ({ buyer: `b${i}.testnet`, seats: 1, state: 'committed' as const }));
    chain.seats.set(3, seats);
    expect((await chain.listPools(0, 1000)).map((pool) => pool.id)).toEqual([...Array(100).keys()]);
    expect((await chain.listPools(101, 100)).map((pool) => pool.id)).toEqual([101, 102, 103, 104]);
    expect(await chain.getSeats(3, 100, 100)).toEqual(seats.slice(100));
    expect(await chain.getSeats(3, 0, 2)).toEqual(seats.slice(0, 2));
    expect(await chain.getSeats(9, 0, 100)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('gives a pool as stored, and null for an unknown one', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    chain.setPool(poolView({ id: 4, status: 'settled' }));
    expect(await chain.getPool(4)).toEqual(poolView({ id: 4, status: 'settled' }));
    expect(await chain.getPool(5)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('records each view and token balance read, with the block height it asked for', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    await chain.ftBalanceOf(PROVIDER);
    await chain.ftBalanceOf(POOLS, 7n);
    await chain.getPool(3);
    await chain.listPools(0, 100, 8n);
    await chain.getSeats(3, 0, 100);
    expect(chain.reads).toEqual([
      { method: 'ftBalanceOf', args: [PROVIDER], atHeight: null },
      { method: 'ftBalanceOf', args: [POOLS], atHeight: 7n },
      { method: 'getPool', args: [3], atHeight: null },
      { method: 'listPools', args: [0, 100], atHeight: 8n },
      { method: 'getSeats', args: [3, 0, 100], atHeight: null },
    ]);
  });

  it('gives the final block it is given', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    expect(await chain.finalBlock()).toEqual({ height: 1_000n, timestampMs: NOW_MS });
    chain.block = { height: 5n, timestampMs: 9 };
    expect(await chain.finalBlock()).toEqual({ height: 5n, timestampMs: 9 });
  });

  it('looks an outcome up by hash and signer, and gives null for any other pair', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    const outcome: TxOutcome = { txHash: 'Hash1', receipts: [{ executorId: 'relay.testnet', logs: [], failed: false, gasBurnt: 1n }] };
    chain.addOutcome('relay.testnet', outcome);
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Hash1', 'relay.testnet')).toEqual(outcome);
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Hash1', 'other.testnet')).toBeNull();
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Hash2', 'relay.testnet')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('FakeChain writes', () => {

  it('moves tokens for each transfer of a batch, charging 1 yoctoNEAR per call', async () => {

    chain.register(PROVIDER);
    await chain.ftTransfers(funding, [
      { receiverId: BUYER, amount: 8_000n },
      { receiverId: PROVIDER, amount: 10_000n },
    ]);
    expect(await Promise.all([FUNDING, BUYER, PROVIDER].map((id) => chain.ftBalanceOf(id)))).toEqual([12_000n, 10_000n, 10_000n]);
    expect((await chain.account(FUNDING))?.balance).toBe(NEAR - 2n);
    expect(chain.writes[0]).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'ftTransfers',
      signer: FUNDING,
      transfers: [
        { receiverId: BUYER, amount: 8_000n },
        { receiverId: PROVIDER, amount: 10_000n },
      ],
    });
  });

  it.each([
    ['an unregistered receiver', [{ receiverId: 'nobody.testnet', amount: 1n }]],
    ['a zero amount', [{ receiverId: BUYER, amount: 0n }]],
    ['the sender as receiver', [{ receiverId: FUNDING, amount: 1n }]],
    [
      'more than the sender holds, across the batch',
      [
        { receiverId: BUYER, amount: 600n },
        { receiverId: PROVIDER, amount: 600n },
      ],
    ],
  ])('fails a whole batch of transfers with %s, moving nothing', async (_case, transfers) => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    const funding = chain.addSigner(FUNDING, NEAR);
    chain.register(FUNDING, 1_000n);
    chain.register(BUYER);
    chain.register(PROVIDER);
    await expect(chain.ftTransfers(funding, transfers)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(TransactionFailedError);
    expect(await Promise.all([FUNDING, BUYER, PROVIDER].map((id) => chain.ftBalanceOf(id)))).toEqual([1_000n, 0n, 0n]);
  });

  it('fails a transfer from an unregistered sender', async () => {
    const chain = new FakeChain();
    const funding = chain.addSigner(FUNDING, NEAR);
    chain.register(BUYER);
    await expect(chain.ftTransfers(funding, [{ receiverId: BUYER, amount: 1n }])).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(TransactionFailedError);
  });

  it.each([0, 11])('refuses a batch of %i calls before recording or signing anything', async (size) => {
    const { chain, parent } = setup();
    const ids = Array.from({ length: size }, (_, i) => `b${i}.testnet`);
    await expect(chain.storageDeposits(parent, ids, REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(RangeError);
    const transfers = ids.map((receiverId) => ({ receiverId, amount: 1n }));
    await expect(chain.ftTransfers(parent, transfers)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(RangeError);
    expect(chain.writes).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('accepts a batch of 10 calls', async () => {
    const { chain, parent } = setup();
    const ids = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => `b${i}.testnet`);
    await chain.storageDeposits(parent, ids, REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT);
    expect(chain.registered.size).toBe(10);
  });

  it('charges its fee to the signer of every write that runs', async () => {
    const { chain, parent } = setup();
    chain.txFee = 1_000n;
    chain.addAccount(BUYER);
    await chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 1n);
    await chain.storageDeposits(parent, [BUYER], REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT);
    expect((await chain.account(PARENT))?.balance).toBe(10n * NEAR - 1n - REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT - 2_000n);
  });

  it('needs the signer to hold what heldWhileRunning asks while a write runs, and charges none of it', async () => {
    const { chain, parent } = setup();
    chain.addAccount(BUYER);
    chain.heldWhileRunning = (write) => (write.kind === 'transferNear' ? NEAR : 0n);
    await expect(chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 9n * NEAR + 1n)).rejects.toThrow(`${PARENT} cannot pay`);
    await chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 9n * NEAR);
    expect((await chain.account(PARENT))?.balance).toBe(NEAR);
  });
});

    expect(chain.pools.size).toBe(0);

    expect(await chain.ftBalanceOf(BUYER)).toBe(0n);

    expect(await chain.ftBalanceOf(PROVIDER)).toBe(1_000n);
  });

    const { chain, provider } = withPools();
    const scripted = { outcome: { txHash: 'Scripted1', receipts: [] }, used: 5n };
    chain.onTransferCall = (call) => {
      expect(call).toMatchObject({ signer: PROVIDER, receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n });
      return scripted;
    };
    expect(await chain.ftTransferCall(provider, { receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n, msg: openMsg() })).toEqual(scripted);
    expect(chain.pools.size).toBe(0);
    expect(await chain.ftBalanceOf(PROVIDER)).toBe(10_000n);
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Scripted1', PROVIDER)).toEqual(scripted.outcome);

    const [log] = outcome.receipts.find((receipt) => receipt.executorId === POOLS)?.logs ?? [];
    expect(log?.startsWith('EVENT_JSON:{"standard":"quorum","version":"1.0.0","event":"pool_opened","data":[{')).toBe(true);
    expect(parseEventLog(log ?? '')?.event).toBe('pool_opened');
  });
});

describe('FakeChain.failWrite', () => {
  it('fails the first matching write with a TransactionFailedError, records it, and changes nothing', async () => {
    const { chain, parent } = setup();
    chain.addAccount(BUYER);
    chain.failWrite((write) => write.kind === 'transferNear' && write.amount === 2n);
    await chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 1n);
    const error = await chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 2n).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(TransactionFailedError);
    expect((error as TransactionFailedError).outcome.receipts.map((r) => [r.executorId, r.failed])).toEqual([
      [PARENT, false],
      [BUYER, true],
    ]);
    expect((await chain.account(BUYER))?.balance).toBe(1n);
    expect(chain.writes.map((write) => write.kind === 'transferNear' && write.amount)).toEqual([1n, 2n]);
  });

  it('fails only once', async () => {
    const { chain, parent } = setup();
    chain.addAccount(BUYER);
    chain.failWrite(() => true);
    await expect(chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 1n)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(TransactionFailedError);
    await chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 1n);
    expect((await chain.account(BUYER))?.balance).toBe(1n);
  });

  it('throws the given error instead, such as a send whose result is unknown', async () => {
    const { chain, parent } = setup();
    const sent = new Error('fetch failed');
    chain.failWrite((write) => write.kind === 'createAccount', sent);
    await expect(chain.createAccount(parent, { accountId: BUYER, balance: 1n, publicKeys: [] })).rejects.toBe(sent);
    expect(await chain.account(BUYER)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { poolsEvents, type TxOutcome } from '@quorum-on-near/protocol';
import { baseEncode, encodeTransaction, KeyPair, type Action, type Provider, type SignedTransaction } from 'near-api-js';
import {
  AccountDoesNotExistError,
  InvalidNonceError,
  InvalidTransactionError,
  TransactionTimeoutError,
  UnknownBlockError,
  UnknownTransactionError,
} from 'near-api-js/rpc-errors';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { NonceTakenError, OutcomeUnknownError, TGAS, TransactionFailedError, type AccountKey } from '../src/chain.ts';
import { createRpcSwarmChain, RpcSwarmChain } from '../src/rpc-chain.ts';
import { eventLog, PARENT, POOLS, PROVIDER, TOKEN } from './fake-chain.ts';

const BUYER = `buyer-01.${PARENT}`;
const FINAL = { finality: 'final' };
const BLOCK_HASH = baseEncode(new Uint8Array(32).fill(7));
/** The code hash of an account without a contract: 32 zero bytes in base58. */
const NO_CODE = '11111111111111111111111111111111';

/** A transaction as the stub RPC received it. */
interface SentTx {
  hash: string;
  signerId: string;
  publicKey: string;
  nonce: bigint;
  receiverId: string;
  actions: Action[];
  waitUntil: string;
}

/** One receipt of a stubbed response. */
interface ReceiptSpec {
  executorId: string;
  status?: Record<string, unknown>;
  logs?: string[];
  gasBurnt?: number;
}

function outcomeEntry(id: string, executorId: string, status: Record<string, unknown>, logs: string[], gasBurnt: number) {
  return {
    id,
    block_hash: BLOCK_HASH,
    proof: [],
    outcome: { executor_id: executorId, logs, receipt_ids: [], gas_burnt: gasBurnt, tokens_burnt: '0', status },
  };
}

/** A `send_tx` response at FINAL: the transaction at its signer, then `receipts`, with `status` at the top. */
function finalResponse(tx: SentTx, receipts: ReceiptSpec[], status: Record<string, unknown> = { SuccessValue: '' }) {
  return {
    final_execution_status: 'FINAL',
    status,
    transaction: { hash: tx.hash, signer_id: tx.signerId, receiver_id: tx.receiverId, nonce: Number(tx.nonce) },
    transaction_outcome: outcomeEntry(tx.hash, tx.signerId, { SuccessReceiptId: `${tx.hash}-0` }, [], 2_428_000_000_000),
    receipts_outcome: receipts.map((r, i) =>
      outcomeEntry(`${tx.hash}-${i}`, r.executorId, r.status ?? { SuccessValue: '' }, r.logs ?? [], r.gasBurnt ?? 1_000_000_000_000),
    ),
  };
}

/** The base64 of a JSON value, as a SuccessValue holds a function's result. */
const successValue = (value: unknown) => ({ SuccessValue: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value)).toString('base64') });

/** A contract panic, as a receipt's or a transaction's status reports it. */
const PANIC = { Failure: { ActionError: { index: 0, kind: { FunctionCallError: { ExecutionError: 'Smart contract panicked: no' } } } } };

/**
 * A scripted RPC node: reads through `readProvider`, which has no send method, and sends (with the
 * nonce and block reads near-api-js makes for them) through `sendProvider`.
 */
class FakeRpc {
  chainNonce = 40n;
  accessKeyReads = 0;
  sent: SentTx[] = [];
  reads: Array<[method: string, params: unknown]> = [];
  /** The send's response; by default the transaction and one receipt at its receiver succeed. */
  onSend: (tx: SentTx) => Promise<unknown> = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: tx.receiverId }]);
  /** What a read answers, by provider method; a function is called, and may throw. */
  answers: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  /** Records a read and gives what `answers` holds for its method. */
  async answer(method: string, params: unknown): Promise<unknown> {
    this.reads.push([method, params]);
    const value = this.answers[method];
    return typeof value === 'function' ? (value as () => unknown)() : value;
  }

  readProvider(): Provider {
    const answer = (method: string, params: unknown): Promise<unknown> => this.answer(method, params);
    const read = {
      viewNodeStatus: () => answer('viewNodeStatus', undefined),
      viewAccount: (params: unknown) => answer('viewAccount', params),
      callFunction: (params: unknown) => answer('callFunction', params),
      viewBlock: (params: unknown) => answer('viewBlock', params),
      viewTransactionStatus: (params: unknown) => answer('viewTransactionStatus', params),
    };
    return read as unknown as Provider;
  }

  /** Sends, and the wait for a transaction to be final, which is answered as `send.viewTransactionStatus`. */
  sendProvider(): Provider {
    const send = {
      viewTransactionStatus: (params: unknown) => this.answer('send.viewTransactionStatus', params),
      viewAccessKey: async () => {
        this.accessKeyReads += 1;
        return { nonce: this.chainNonce, permission: 'FullAccess', block_height: 1_000, block_hash: BLOCK_HASH };
      },
      viewBlock: async () => ({ header: { height: 1_000, hash: BLOCK_HASH } }),
      sendTransactionUntil: async (signed: SignedTransaction, waitUntil: string) => {
        const { transaction } = signed;
        const tx: SentTx = {
          hash: baseEncode(createHash('sha256').update(encodeTransaction(transaction)).digest()),
          signerId: transaction.signerId,
          publicKey: transaction.publicKey.toString(),
          nonce: transaction.nonce,
          receiverId: transaction.receiverId,
          actions: transaction.actions,
          waitUntil,
        };
        this.sent.push(tx);
        return this.onSend(tx);
      },
    };
    return send as unknown as Provider;
  }
}

function setup() {
  const rpc = new FakeRpc();
  const chain = new RpcSwarmChain({
    readProvider: rpc.readProvider(),
    sendProvider: rpc.sendProvider(),
    token: TOKEN,
    poolsContract: POOLS,
  });
  return { rpc, chain };
}

const signer = (accountId: string): AccountKey => ({ accountId, keyPair: KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519') });

/** An action as a plain value, so that a test can compare whole action lists. */
function plain(action: Action): unknown {
  if (action.createAccount) return 'createAccount';
  if (action.transfer) return { transfer: action.transfer.deposit };
  if (action.addKey) {
    return { addKey: action.addKey.publicKey.toString(), fullAccess: action.addKey.accessKey.permission.fullAccess !== undefined };
  }
  if (action.deployContract) return { deployContract: [...action.deployContract.code] };
  if (action.functionCall) {
    const { methodName, args, gas, deposit } = action.functionCall;
    return { call: methodName, args: JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(args))), gas, deposit };
  }
  throw new Error(`unexpected action ${action.enum}`);
}

interface Deferred {
  promise: Promise<void>;
  resolve(): void;
}

function deferred(): Deferred {
  let resolve!: () => void;
  const promise = new Promise<void>((r) => {
    resolve = r;
  });
  return { promise, resolve };
}

/** Lets every pending promise callback and I/O callback run. */
const settle = (): Promise<void> => new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.answers.viewAccount = { amount: 5n, locked: 0n, code_hash: NO_CODE, storage_usage: 182 };
    expect(await chain.account(BUYER)).toEqual({ balance: 5n, hasCode: false, storageUsage: 182n });
    expect(rpc.reads).toEqual([['viewAccount', { accountId: BUYER, blockQuery: FINAL }]]);
    rpc.answers.viewAccount = { amount: 7n, locked: 0n, code_hash: 'E8jZ1giWcVrps8PcV75ATauu6gFRkcwjNtKp7NKmipZG', storage_usage: 204_022 };
    expect(await chain.account(POOLS)).toEqual({ balance: 7n, hasCode: true, storageUsage: 204_022n });
  });

  it('account returns null for an account that does not exist, and passes on any other error', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.answers.viewAccount = () => {
      throw new AccountDoesNotExistError(BUYER, BLOCK_HASH, 1_000);
    };
    expect(await chain.account(BUYER)).toBeNull();
    rpc.answers.viewAccount = () => {
      throw new UnknownBlockError();
    };
    await expect(chain.account(BUYER)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnknownBlockError);
  });

  it('finalBlock reads the latest final block, its timestamp in milliseconds', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.answers.viewBlock = { header: { height: 245_000_100, hash: BLOCK_HASH, timestamp_nanosec: '1799999000123999999' } };
    expect(await chain.finalBlock()).toEqual({ height: 245_000_100n, timestampMs: 1_799_999_000_123 });
    expect(rpc.reads).toEqual([['viewBlock', FINAL]]);
  });

  const relayed: SentTx = { hash: 'Tx1', signerId: 'relay.testnet', publicKey: '', nonce: 1n, receiverId: BUYER, actions: [], waitUntil: '' };
  const relayedOutcome: TxOutcome = {
    txHash: 'Tx1',
    receipts: [
      { executorId: 'relay.testnet', logs: [], failed: false, gasBurnt: 2_428_000_000_000n },
      { executorId: BUYER, logs: ['hello'], failed: false, gasBurnt: 3_000_000_000_000n },
    ],
  };
  const lookup = (waitUntil: string) => ({ txHash: 'Tx1', accountId: 'relay.testnet', waitUntil });

  it('txOutcome looks the transaction up without waiting, and converts it when it is final already', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.answers.viewTransactionStatus = finalResponse(relayed, [{ executorId: BUYER, gasBurnt: 3_000_000_000_000, logs: ['hello'] }]);
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Tx1', 'relay.testnet')).toEqual<TxOutcome>(relayedOutcome);
    expect(rpc.reads).toEqual([['viewTransactionStatus', lookup('NONE')]]);
  });

  it('txOutcome waits for a transaction the RPC knows to be final, through the provider that sends each request once', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.answers.viewTransactionStatus = { final_execution_status: 'EXECUTED_OPTIMISTIC' };
    rpc.answers['send.viewTransactionStatus'] = finalResponse(relayed, [{ executorId: BUYER, gasBurnt: 3_000_000_000_000, logs: ['hello'] }]);
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Tx1', 'relay.testnet')).toEqual<TxOutcome>(relayedOutcome);
    expect(rpc.reads).toEqual([
      ['viewTransactionStatus', lookup('NONE')],
      ['send.viewTransactionStatus', lookup('FINAL')],
    ]);
  });

  it('txOutcome is null at once for a transaction the RPC does not know, such as one older than its history', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.answers.viewTransactionStatus = () => {
      throw new UnknownTransactionError('Tx1');
    };
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Tx1', 'relay.testnet')).toBeNull();
    expect(rpc.reads).toEqual([['viewTransactionStatus', lookup('NONE')]]);
  });

  it.each([
    ['a 408', () => new Error('Timeout error', { cause: 408 })],
    ['TIMEOUT_ERROR', () => new TransactionTimeoutError()],
    ['UNKNOWN_TRANSACTION', () => new UnknownTransactionError('Tx1')],
  ])('txOutcome is null when the wait for the transaction to be final ends with %s', async (_, error) => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.answers.viewTransactionStatus = { final_execution_status: 'INCLUDED' };
    rpc.answers['send.viewTransactionStatus'] = () => {
      throw error();
    };
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Tx1', 'relay.testnet')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('txOutcome passes on any other error', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.answers.viewTransactionStatus = () => {
      throw new UnknownBlockError();
    };
    await expect(chain.txOutcome('Tx1', 'relay.testnet')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnknownBlockError);
    rpc.answers.viewTransactionStatus = { final_execution_status: 'INCLUDED' };
    rpc.answers['send.viewTransactionStatus'] = () => {
      throw new Error('Bad Gateway', { cause: 502 });
    };
    await expect(chain.txOutcome('Tx1', 'relay.testnet')).rejects.toThrow('Bad Gateway');
  });
});

describe('RpcSwarmChain writes', () => {
  it('creates a sub-account with its balance and every key as a full-access key, waiting until final', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const parent = signer(PARENT);
    const keys = [KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519').getPublicKey(), KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519').getPublicKey()];
    await chain.createAccount(parent, { accountId: 'relay.parent.testnet', balance: 3n, publicKeys: keys });
    const [tx] = rpc.sent;
    expect(tx).toMatchObject({
      signerId: PARENT,
      publicKey: parent.keyPair.getPublicKey().toString(),
      receiverId: 'relay.parent.testnet',
      waitUntil: 'FINAL',
    });
    expect(tx?.actions.map(plain)).toEqual([
      'createAccount',
      { transfer: 3n },
      { addKey: keys[0]?.toString(), fullAccess: true },
      { addKey: keys[1]?.toString(), fullAccess: true },
    ]);
  });

  it('transfers NEAR', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    await chain.transferNear(signer(PARENT), BUYER, 50_000_000_000_000_000_000_000n);
    expect(rpc.sent[0]?.receiverId).toBe(BUYER);
    expect(rpc.sent[0]?.actions.map(plain)).toEqual([{ transfer: 50_000_000_000_000_000_000_000n }]);
  });

  it("deploys the pools contract to the signer's own account and initialises it with the token in the same transaction", async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    await chain.deployPools(signer('escrow.testnet'), new Uint8Array([0, 97, 115, 109]));
    expect(rpc.sent[0]).toMatchObject({ signerId: 'escrow.testnet', receiverId: 'escrow.testnet' });
    expect(rpc.sent[0]?.actions.map(plain)).toEqual([
      { deployContract: [0, 97, 115, 109] },
      { call: 'new', args: { token: TOKEN }, gas: 30n * TGAS, deposit: 0n },
    ]);
  });

  it('registers accounts with one storage_deposit each, registration only, 20 Tgas each', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    await chain.storageDeposits(signer(PARENT), [BUYER, POOLS], 1_250n);
    expect(rpc.sent[0]?.receiverId).toBe(TOKEN);
    expect(rpc.sent[0]?.actions.map(plain)).toEqual([
      { call: 'storage_deposit', args: { account_id: BUYER, registration_only: true }, gas: 20n * TGAS, deposit: 1_250n },
      { call: 'storage_deposit', args: { account_id: POOLS, registration_only: true }, gas: 20n * TGAS, deposit: 1_250n },
    ]);
  });

  it('sends a batch of ft_transfer calls with 1 yoctoNEAR and 20 Tgas each', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const funding = signer(`funding.${PARENT}`);
    await chain.ftTransfers(funding, [
      { receiverId: BUYER, amount: 8_000n },
      { receiverId: PROVIDER, amount: 10_000n },
    ]);
    expect(rpc.sent[0]).toMatchObject({ signerId: funding.accountId, receiverId: TOKEN });
    expect(rpc.sent[0]?.actions.map(plain)).toEqual([
      { call: 'ft_transfer', args: { receiver_id: BUYER, amount: '8000' }, gas: 20n * TGAS, deposit: 1n },
      { call: 'ft_transfer', args: { receiver_id: PROVIDER, amount: '10000' }, gas: 20n * TGAS, deposit: 1n },
    ]);
  });

  it('sends one ft_transfer_call with 1 yoctoNEAR and 100 Tgas', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN }], successValue('1728'));
    await chain.ftTransferCall(signer(PROVIDER), { receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n, msg: '{"open":{}}' });
    expect(rpc.sent[0]).toMatchObject({ signerId: PROVIDER, receiverId: TOKEN });
    expect(rpc.sent[0]?.actions.map(plain)).toEqual([
      { call: 'ft_transfer_call', args: { receiver_id: POOLS, amount: '1728', msg: '{"open":{}}' }, gas: 100n * TGAS, deposit: 1n },
    ]);
  });

  it.each([0, 11])('refuses a batch of %i calls before signing anything', async (size) => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const ids = Array.from({ length: size }, (_, i) => `b${i}.testnet`);
    await expect(chain.storageDeposits(signer(PARENT), ids, 1n)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(RangeError);
    const transfers = ids.map((receiverId) => ({ receiverId, amount: 1n }));
    await expect(chain.ftTransfers(signer(PARENT), transfers)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(RangeError);
    expect(rpc.sent).toEqual([]);
    expect(rpc.accessKeyReads).toBe(0);
  });

  it('sends a batch of 10 calls in one transaction', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const ids = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => `b${i}.testnet`);
    await chain.storageDeposits(signer(PARENT), ids, 1n);
    expect(rpc.sent).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(rpc.sent[0]?.actions).toHaveLength(10);
  });

  it("returns the write's outcome, converted from the final response", async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN, gasBurnt: 4_000_000_000_000, logs: ['EVENT_JSON:{}'] }, { executorId: PARENT, gasBurnt: 0 }]);
    const outcome = await chain.ftTransfers(signer(PARENT), [{ receiverId: BUYER, amount: 1n }]);
    expect(outcome).toEqual<TxOutcome>({
      txHash: rpc.sent[0]?.hash ?? '',
      receipts: [
        { executorId: PARENT, logs: [], failed: false, gasBurnt: 2_428_000_000_000n },
        { executorId: TOKEN, logs: ['EVENT_JSON:{}'], failed: false, gasBurnt: 4_000_000_000_000n },
        { executorId: PARENT, logs: [], failed: false, gasBurnt: 0n },
      ],
    });
  });
});

describe('RpcSwarmChain failure detection', () => {
  it('throws TransactionFailedError when the transaction failed, naming it and its failure', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN, status: PANIC }], PANIC);
    const error = await chain.ftTransfers(signer(PARENT), [{ receiverId: BUYER, amount: 1n }]).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(TransactionFailedError);
    const { message, outcome } = error as TransactionFailedError;
    expect(outcome.receipts.map((receipt) => receipt.failed)).toEqual([false, true]);
    expect(message).toContain(rpc.sent[0]?.hash);
    expect(message).toContain(`from ${PARENT} to ${TOKEN}`);
    expect(message).toContain('Smart contract panicked: no');
  });

  it('throws TransactionFailedError when a later receipt failed, though the transaction reports success', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: BUYER }, { executorId: POOLS, status: PANIC }]);
    const error = await chain.transferNear(signer(PARENT), BUYER, 1n).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(TransactionFailedError);
    expect((error as TransactionFailedError).message).toContain(`a receipt executed by ${POOLS} failed`);
  });

  it.each([
    ['a TIMEOUT_ERROR', () => new TransactionTimeoutError(), 'timeout'],
    ['a 408', () => new Error('Timeout error', { cause: 408 }), 'timeout'],
    ['a 503', () => new Error('http://rpc.invalid unavailable', { cause: 503 }), 'HTTP 503'],
    ['a failed request', () => new TypeError('fetch failed', { cause: Object.assign(new Error('reset'), { code: 'ECONNRESET' }) }), 'ECONNRESET'],
  ])('rejects OutcomeUnknownError, its cause kept, when a send gets %s instead of a result', async (_, error, reason) => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const thrown = error();
    rpc.onSend = async () => {
      throw thrown;
    };
    const rejected = await chain.transferNear(signer(PARENT), BUYER, 1n).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(rejected).toBeInstanceOf(OutcomeUnknownError);
    expect(rejected).toMatchObject({ txHash: null, reason, cause: thrown });
    expect((rejected as Error).message).toBe(
      `a transaction from ${PARENT} to ${BUYER} may have been sent, but the RPC gave no result (${reason}): it may still run`,
    );
  });

  it('passes on the error of a send the RPC refused', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const refusal = new InvalidTransactionError();
    rpc.onSend = async () => {
      throw refusal;
    };
    await expect(chain.transferNear(signer(PARENT), BUYER, 1n)).rejects.toBe(refusal);
  });

  it('passes on the conversion error of a response that is not final', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => ({ ...finalResponse(tx, []), final_execution_status: 'INCLUDED' });
    await expect(chain.transferNear(signer(PARENT), BUYER, 1n)).rejects.toThrow('not executed yet');
  });
});

describe('RpcSwarmChain.ftTransferCall', () => {
  const call = { receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n, msg: '{"open":{}}' };
  const opened = eventLog({
    event: 'pool_opened',
    data: { pool_id: 3, seller: PROVIDER, seat_price: '180', target: 192, deadline_ms: 1, bonus: '1728', terms: 't' },
  });

  it('returns the outcome and the amount the token kept, the call’s result', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) =>
      finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN }, { executorId: POOLS, logs: [opened] }, { executorId: TOKEN }], successValue('1728'));
    const { outcome, used } = await chain.ftTransferCall(signer(PROVIDER), call);
    expect(used).toBe(1_728n);
    expect(poolsEvents(outcome, POOLS).map((event) => event.event)).toEqual(['pool_opened']);
  });

  it("returns, without throwing, a call whose receiver failed and that the token returned", async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) =>
      finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN }, { executorId: POOLS, status: PANIC }, { executorId: TOKEN }], successValue('0'));
    const { outcome, used } = await chain.ftTransferCall(signer(PROVIDER), call);
    expect(used).toBe(0n);
    expect(outcome.receipts.map((receipt) => receipt.failed)).toEqual([false, false, true, false]);
  });

  it('throws TransactionFailedError when the call itself failed', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN, status: PANIC }], PANIC);
    await expect(chain.ftTransferCall(signer(PROVIDER), call)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(TransactionFailedError);
  });

  it.each([[successValue(1728)], [{ SuccessValue: '' }], [successValue('-1')]])(
    'refuses a result %j that is not an amount',
    async (status) => {
      const { rpc, chain } = setup();
      rpc.onSend = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN }], status);
      await expect(chain.ftTransferCall(signer(PROVIDER), call)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    },
  );
});

describe('RpcSwarmChain signers', () => {
  it('reads a key’s nonce once, then numbers its transactions from it', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const parent = signer(PARENT);
    await chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 1n);
    await chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 2n);
    expect(rpc.accessKeyReads).toBe(1);
    expect(rpc.sent.map((tx) => tx.nonce)).toEqual([41n, 42n]);
  });

  it('sends the writes of one key one after another, even when they are started together', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const parent = signer(PARENT);
    const gate = deferred();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => {
      if (tx.nonce === 41n) await gate.promise;
      return finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: tx.receiverId }]);
    };
    const first = chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 1n);
    const second = chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 2n);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(rpc.sent).toHaveLength(1));
    await settle();
    expect(rpc.sent).toHaveLength(1);
    gate.resolve();
    await Promise.all([first, second]);
    expect(rpc.sent.map((tx) => [tx.nonce, tx.actions.map(plain)])).toEqual([
      [41n, [{ transfer: 1n }]],
      [42n, [{ transfer: 2n }]],
    ]);
  });

  it('sends the writes of different keys at the same time', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const gate = deferred();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => {
      if (tx.signerId === PARENT) await gate.promise;
      return finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: tx.receiverId }]);
    };
    const blocked = chain.transferNear(signer(PARENT), BUYER, 1n);
    await chain.transferNear(signer(PROVIDER), BUYER, 2n);
    expect(rpc.sent.map((tx) => tx.signerId)).toEqual([PARENT, PROVIDER]);
    gate.resolve();
    await blocked;
  });

  it('goes on with a key’s next write after one fails', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const parent = signer(PARENT);
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => {
      if (tx.nonce === 41n) throw new TransactionTimeoutError();
      return finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: tx.receiverId }]);
    };
    const first = chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 1n);
    const second = chain.transferNear(parent, BUYER, 2n);
    await expect(first).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(OutcomeUnknownError);
    await second;
    expect(rpc.sent.map((tx) => tx.nonce)).toEqual([41n, 42n]);
  });
});

describe('RpcSwarmChain nonces', () => {
  /** An InvalidNonce answer, as near-api-js parses one: the key's nonce on chain is past the transaction's. */
  const invalidNonce = (tx: SentTx, onChain: bigint) => new InvalidNonceError(Number(onChain), Number(tx.nonce), tx.hash, BLOCK_HASH);

  it('re-signs a batch of ft_transfer calls once with a nonce read again after an InvalidNonce answer, posting each signed transaction once', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const funding = signer(`funding.${PARENT}`);
    // Another process signed with the key after this one read its nonce.
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => {
      if (tx.nonce === 41n) {
        rpc.chainNonce = 45n;
        throw invalidNonce(tx, 45n);
      }
      return finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: tx.receiverId }]);
    };
    const outcome = await chain.ftTransfers(funding, [{ receiverId: BUYER, amount: 8_000n }]);
    expect(rpc.accessKeyReads).toBe(2);
    expect(rpc.sent.map((tx) => tx.nonce)).toEqual([41n, 46n]);
    expect(new Set(rpc.sent.map((tx) => tx.hash)).size).toBe(2);
    expect(outcome.txHash).toBe(rpc.sent[1]?.hash);
  });

  it('signs the bonus ft_transfer_call with a nonce read for it alone, and numbers the key’s later writes from it', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const provider = signer(PROVIDER);
    await chain.transferNear(provider, BUYER, 1n);
    rpc.chainNonce = 41n;
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN }], successValue('1728'));
    const { outcome } = await chain.ftTransferCall(provider, { receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n, msg: '{"open":{}}' });
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: tx.receiverId }]);
    await chain.transferNear(provider, BUYER, 2n);
    expect(rpc.accessKeyReads).toBe(2);
    expect(rpc.sent.map((tx) => tx.nonce)).toEqual([41n, 42n, 43n]);
    expect(outcome.txHash).toBe(rpc.sent[1]?.hash);
  });

  it('never re-signs the bonus ft_transfer_call: an InvalidNonce answer rejects NonceTakenError naming it, after one send', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => {
      rpc.chainNonce = 45n;
      throw invalidNonce(tx, 45n);
    };
    const rejected = await chain.ftTransferCall(signer(PROVIDER), { receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n, msg: '{"open":{}}' }).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(rejected).toBeInstanceOf(NonceTakenError);
    expect(rpc.sent).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(rejected).toMatchObject({ txHash: rpc.sent[0]?.hash });
    expect((rejected as Error).message).toBe(
      `transaction ${rpc.sent[0]?.hash} from ${PROVIDER} to ${TOKEN} was refused: another transaction of the key took its nonce after it was read`,
    );
  });

  it('names the bonus ft_transfer_call in the OutcomeUnknownError of a send that got no result, sent once', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    rpc.onSend = async () => {
      throw new Error('Timeout error', { cause: 408 });
    };
    const rejected = await chain.ftTransferCall(signer(PROVIDER), { receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n, msg: '{"open":{}}' }).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(rejected).toBeInstanceOf(OutcomeUnknownError);
    expect(rpc.sent).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(rejected).toMatchObject({ txHash: rpc.sent[0]?.hash, reason: 'timeout' });
    expect((rejected as Error).message).toBe(
      `transaction ${rpc.sent[0]?.hash} from ${PROVIDER} to ${TOKEN} was sent, but the RPC gave no result (timeout): it may still run`,
    );
  });

  it('passes on a refusal of the bonus ft_transfer_call as it is', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const refusal = new InvalidTransactionError();
    rpc.onSend = async () => {
      throw refusal;
    };
    await expect(chain.ftTransferCall(signer(PROVIDER), { receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n, msg: '{"open":{}}' })).rejects.toBe(refusal);
  });

  it('sends the bonus ft_transfer_call only once the key’s previous write has settled', async () => {
    const { rpc, chain } = setup();
    const provider = signer(PROVIDER);
    const gate = deferred();
    rpc.onSend = async (tx) => {
      if (tx.nonce === 41n) await gate.promise;
      return finalResponse(tx, [{ executorId: TOKEN }], successValue('1728'));
    };
    const first = chain.transferNear(provider, BUYER, 1n);
    const bonus = chain.ftTransferCall(provider, { receiverId: POOLS, amount: 1_728n, msg: '{"open":{}}' });
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(rpc.sent).toHaveLength(1));
    await settle();
    expect(rpc.sent).toHaveLength(1);
    rpc.chainNonce = 41n;
    gate.resolve();
    await Promise.all([first, bonus]);
    expect(rpc.sent.map((tx) => tx.nonce)).toEqual([41n, 42n]);
  });
});

describe('createRpcSwarmChain', () => {
  it('asks the RPC once to wait for a transaction to be final: an RPC that answers 408 is not asked again', async () => {
    const waits: string[] = [];
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', async (_url: string, init: { body: string }) => {
      const request = JSON.parse(init.body) as { id: string; method: string; params: Record<string, unknown> };
      if (request.method !== 'tx') throw new Error(`unexpected ${request.method}`);
      waits.push(String(request.params.wait_until));
      if (request.params.wait_until === 'FINAL') return new Response('timeout', { status: 408 });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: request.id, result: { final_execution_status: 'INCLUDED' } }), { status: 200 });
    });
    const chain = createRpcSwarmChain({ rpcUrl: 'http://rpc.invalid', token: TOKEN, poolsContract: POOLS });
    expect(await chain.txOutcome('Tx1', 'relay.testnet')).toBeNull();
    expect(waits).toEqual(['NONE', 'FINAL']);
  });

  it('posts each signed transaction once, even when the RPC answers 503', async () => {
    const methods: string[] = [];
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', async (_url: string, init: { body: string }) => {
      const request = JSON.parse(init.body) as { id: string; method: string; params: Record<string, unknown> };
      methods.push(request.method);
      if (request.method === 'send_tx') return new Response('unavailable', { status: 503 });
      const result =
        request.method === 'block'
          ? { header: { height: 1_000, hash: BLOCK_HASH, timestamp_nanosec: '0' } }
          : { nonce: 40, permission: 'FullAccess', block_height: 1_000, block_hash: BLOCK_HASH };
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: request.id, result }), { status: 200 });
    });
    const chain = createRpcSwarmChain({ rpcUrl: 'http://rpc.invalid', token: TOKEN, poolsContract: POOLS });
    await expect(chain.transferNear(signer(PARENT), BUYER, 1n)).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(methods.filter((method) => method === 'send_tx')).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
```

`apps/swarm/src/rpc-chain.ts`:

```typescript
import { transportReason, type BuyerSettings } from '@quorum-on-near/buyer';
import { ONE_YOCTO, parseAmount, toTxOutcome, type PoolView, type SeatView } from '@quorum-on-near/protocol';
import {
  Account,
  actions,
  baseEncode,
  getTransactionLastResult,
  JsonRpcProvider,
  KeyPairSigner,
  type Action,
  type Provider,
  type SerializedReturnValue,
} from 'near-api-js';
import { AccountDoesNotExistError, InvalidNonceError, TransactionTimeoutError, UnknownTransactionError } from 'near-api-js/rpc-errors';
import {
  assertBatchSize,
  BATCHED_CALL_GAS,
  NonceTakenError,
  OutcomeUnknownError,
  TGAS,
  TransactionFailedError,
  type AccountKey,
  type AccountState,
  type BlockInfo,
  type NewAccount,
  type ReadAt,
  type SwarmChain,
  type TokenTransfer,
  type TransferCall,
  type TransferCallResult,
  type TxOutcome,
} from './chain.ts';

const FINAL = { finality: 'final' } as const;
const OPTIMISTIC = { finality: 'optimistic' } as const;
const NANOS_PER_MS = 1_000_000n;
/** Gas for the pools contract's `new`, called in its deploy transaction. */
const INIT_GAS = 30n * TGAS;
/** Gas for one `ft_transfer_call`: the token's transfer, the receiver's `ft_on_transfer`, then `ft_resolve_transfer`. */
const TRANSFER_CALL_GAS = 100n * TGAS;
/** The code hash of an account that holds no contract: 32 zero bytes, in base58. */
const NO_CODE_HASH = '11111111111111111111111111111111';

type TransactionResponse = Awaited<ReturnType<Account['signAndSendTransaction']>>;

export interface RpcSwarmChainOptions {
  /** Views, accounts, blocks and transaction lookups. */
  readProvider: Provider;
  /**
   * Writes, with the nonce and block reads near-api-js makes to build them, and txOutcome's wait for a
   * transaction to be final. Construct it with `retries: 1`: near-api-js counts attempts, so each
   * signed transaction is then posted once, and a wait that the RPC ends with a 408 is not repeated.
   */
  sendProvider: Provider;
  token: string;
  poolsContract: string;
}

/**
 * An RpcSwarmChain on `settings.rpcUrl`: its reads keep near-api-js's default retries, since they
 * change nothing; its writes, and its wait for a transaction to be final, go through a provider with
 * `retries: 1`, which posts each signed transaction once and asks for each wait once.
 */
export function createRpcSwarmChain(settings: Pick<BuyerSettings, 'rpcUrl' | 'token' | 'poolsContract'>): RpcSwarmChain {
  return new RpcSwarmChain({
    readProvider: new JsonRpcProvider({ url: settings.rpcUrl }),
    sendProvider: new JsonRpcProvider({ url: settings.rpcUrl }, { retries: 1 }),
    token: settings.token,
    poolsContract: settings.poolsContract,
  });
}

/**
 * SwarmChain over near-api-js's JSON-RPC provider. Reads are at final finality, or at the block
 * height a caller gives (`block_id` in the RPC's query), or, for `list_pools`, at optimistic finality
 * when asked. Each write is one transaction, signed by one near-api-js Account per key, which caches
 * the key's nonce, and sent once that key's previous write has settled, so a key never has two
 * transactions in flight. It waits until the transaction is FINAL, then checks every receipt of the
 * outcome: near-api-js's own check reads only the transaction's final status, which reports success
 * when a later receipt, such as a receiver's callback, failed.
 *
 * Every write but ftTransferCall goes through near-api-js's signAndSendTransaction, whose re-sign
 * the swarm relies on: on an InvalidNonce answer, which means the transaction did not run, it drops
 * the key's cached nonce and signs the transaction again with one read afresh. A key used by another
 * process after this one read its nonce, as the command line's child process does in the sandbox
 * suite before its in-process reset, is so recovered. ftTransferCall signs first, so that its hash is
 * known, and sends once.
 */
export class RpcSwarmChain implements SwarmChain {
  readonly #read: Provider;
  readonly #send: Provider;
  readonly #token: string;
  readonly #poolsContract: string;
  /** Per signing key: its Account, and its latest write, which the next one waits for. */
  readonly #signers = new Map<string, { account: Account; latest: Promise<unknown> }>();

  constructor(opts: RpcSwarmChainOptions) {
    this.#read = opts.readProvider;
    this.#send = opts.sendProvider;
    this.#token = opts.token;
    this.#poolsContract = opts.poolsContract;
  }

  async chainId(): Promise<string> {
    return (await this.#read.viewNodeStatus()).chain_id;
  }

  async account(accountId: string): Promise<AccountState | null> {
    try {
      const view = await this.#read.viewAccount({ accountId, blockQuery: FINAL });
      return { balance: view.amount, hasCode: view.code_hash !== NO_CODE_HASH, storageUsage: BigInt(view.storage_usage) };
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof AccountDoesNotExistError) return null;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<string> {
    const token = await this.#view(this.#poolsContract, 'get_token', {});
    if (typeof token !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`get_token returned ${JSON.stringify(token)}`);
    return token;
  }

  async registrationDeposit(): Promise<bigint> {
    const bounds = await this.#view<{ min?: unknown }>(this.#token, 'storage_balance_bounds', {});
    const min = parseAmount(bounds?.min);
    if (min === null) throw new TypeError(`storage_balance_bounds returned ${JSON.stringify(bounds)}`);
    return min;
  }

  async isRegistered(accountId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    // An unregistered account's storage balance is JSON null, which near-api-js passes on as null.
    const balance = await this.#view(this.#token, 'storage_balance_of', { account_id: accountId });
    return balance !== undefined && balance !== null;
  }

  async ftBalanceOf(accountId: string, atHeight?: bigint): Promise<bigint> {
    const result = await this.#view(this.#token, 'ft_balance_of', { account_id: accountId }, atHeight);
    const balance = parseAmount(result);
    if (balance === null) throw new TypeError(`ft_balance_of returned ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
    return balance;
  }

  async getPool(poolId: number): Promise<PoolView | null> {
    return (await this.#view<PoolView>(this.#poolsContract, 'get_pool', { pool_id: poolId })) ?? null;
  }

  async listPools(from: number, limit: number, at?: ReadAt): Promise<PoolView[]> {
    return (await this.#view<PoolView[]>(this.#poolsContract, 'list_pools', { from, limit }, at)) ?? [];
  }

  async getSeats(poolId: number, from: number, limit: number, atHeight?: bigint): Promise<SeatView[]> {
    const args = { pool_id: poolId, from, limit };
    return (await this.#view<SeatView[]>(this.#poolsContract, 'get_seats', args, atHeight)) ?? [];
  }

  async finalBlock(): Promise<BlockInfo> {
    const { header } = await this.#read.viewBlock(FINAL);
    return { height: BigInt(header.height), timestampMs: Number(BigInt(header.timestamp_nanosec) / NANOS_PER_MS) };
  }

  /**
   * Looks the transaction up first without waiting (`wait_until` NONE), which the RPC answers at once,
   * with UNKNOWN_TRANSACTION for a transaction it does not know, one older than its history included:
   * null then. A transaction it knows is converted at once when it is FINAL already, else waited for
   * at FINAL once, through the send provider; a wait that the RPC ends unanswered (an HTTP 408 or a
   * TIMEOUT_ERROR), or with UNKNOWN_TRANSACTION, is null too. Any other error is passed on.
   */
  async txOutcome(txHash: string, signerId: string): Promise<TxOutcome | null> {
    let status: Awaited<ReturnType<Provider['viewTransactionStatus']>>;
    try {
      status = await this.#read.viewTransactionStatus({ txHash, accountId: signerId, waitUntil: 'NONE' });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof UnknownTransactionError) return null;
      throw error;
    }
    if (status.final_execution_status === 'FINAL') return toTxOutcome(status);
    try {
      return toTxOutcome(await this.#send.viewTransactionStatus({ txHash, accountId: signerId, waitUntil: 'FINAL' }));
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof UnknownTransactionError || timedOut(error)) return null;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  createAccount(signer: AccountKey, account: NewAccount): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    const keys = account.publicKeys.map((publicKey) => actions.addFullAccessKey(publicKey));
    return this.#write(signer, account.accountId, [actions.createAccount(), actions.transfer(account.balance), ...keys]);
  }

  transferNear(signer: AccountKey, receiverId: string, amount: bigint): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    return this.#write(signer, receiverId, [actions.transfer(amount)]);
  }

  deployPools(signer: AccountKey, code: Uint8Array): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    const init = actions.functionCall('new', { token: this.#token }, INIT_GAS, 0n);
    return this.#write(signer, signer.accountId, [actions.deployContract(code), init]);
  }

  async storageDeposits(signer: AccountKey, accountIds: readonly string[], deposit: bigint): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    assertBatchSize(accountIds.length);
    const calls = accountIds.map((accountId) =>
      actions.functionCall('storage_deposit', { account_id: accountId, registration_only: true }, BATCHED_CALL_GAS, deposit),
    );
    return this.#write(signer, this.#token, calls);
  }

  async ftTransfers(signer: AccountKey, transfers: readonly TokenTransfer[]): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    assertBatchSize(transfers.length);
    const calls = transfers.map(({ receiverId, amount }) =>
      actions.functionCall('ft_transfer', { receiver_id: receiverId, amount: amount.toString() }, BATCHED_CALL_GAS, ONE_YOCTO),
    );
    return this.#write(signer, this.#token, calls);
  }

  async ftTransferCall(signer: AccountKey, call: TransferCall): Promise<TransferCallResult> {
    const args = { receiver_id: call.receiverId, amount: call.amount.toString(), msg: call.msg };
    const action = actions.functionCall('ft_transfer_call', args, TRANSFER_CALL_GAS, ONE_YOCTO);
    const { response, outcome } = await this.#sendOnce(signer, this.#token, [action]);
    // The call's own status is ft_resolve_transfer's: a failure means the transfer itself failed.
    if (failureOf(response) !== null) throw failed(signer.accountId, this.#token, response, outcome);
    const result = getTransactionLastResult(response);
    const used = parseAmount(result);
    if (used === null) throw new TypeError(`ft_transfer_call returned ${JSON.stringify(result)}, not an amount`);
    return { outcome, used };
  }

  /** Submits the transaction and throws TransactionFailedError if any receipt of its outcome failed. */
  async #write(signer: AccountKey, receiverId: string, actionList: Action[]): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    const { response, outcome } = await this.#submit(signer, receiverId, actionList);
    if (outcome.receipts.some((receipt) => receipt.failed)) throw failed(signer.accountId, receiverId, response, outcome);
    return outcome;
  }

  /**
   * Signs and sends one transaction once the key's previous write has settled, and waits until it is
   * FINAL, through signAndSendTransaction and its re-sign on InvalidNonce. A request that timed out or
   * failed rejects OutcomeUnknownError, its hash unknown. The response's own status is left to the
   * caller.
   */
  async #submit(
    signer: AccountKey,
    receiverId: string,
    actionList: Action[],
  ): Promise<{ response: TransactionResponse; outcome: TxOutcome }> {
    const entry = this.#entry(signer);
    const sent = entry.latest.then(async () => {
      try {
        return await entry.account.signAndSendTransaction({ receiverId, actions: actionList, waitUntil: 'FINAL', throwOnFailure: false });
      } catch (error) {
        throw noResult(error, null, signer.accountId, receiverId);
      }
    });
    entry.latest = sent.catch(() => undefined);
    const response = await sent;
    return { response, outcome: toTxOutcome(response) };
  }

  /**
   * Signs one transaction, once the key's previous write has settled, with a nonce read for it alone
   * by a new Account, which then replaces the key's own, so that the key's next write is numbered
   * after it; then sends it once and waits until it is FINAL. It is never signed again: InvalidNonce
   * rejects NonceTakenError, and a request that timed out or failed OutcomeUnknownError, both naming
   * the transaction. Any other refusal is passed on as it is.
   */
  async #sendOnce(
    signer: AccountKey,
    receiverId: string,
    actionList: Action[],
  ): Promise<{ response: TransactionResponse; outcome: TxOutcome }> {
    const entry = this.#entry(signer);
    const sent = entry.latest.then(async () => {
      const keySigner = new KeyPairSigner(signer.keyPair);
      const account = new Account(signer.accountId, this.#send, keySigner);
      entry.account = account;
      const publicKey = signer.keyPair.getPublicKey();
      const transaction = await account.createTransaction({ receiverId, actions: actionList, publicKey });
      const { txHash: hash, signedTransaction } = await keySigner.signTransaction(transaction);
      const txHash = baseEncode(hash);
      try {
        return await this.#send.sendTransactionUntil(signedTransaction, 'FINAL');
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof InvalidNonceError) {
          const message = `transaction ${txHash} from ${signer.accountId} to ${receiverId} was refused: another transaction of the key took its nonce after it was read`;
          throw new NonceTakenError(message, txHash, { cause: error });
        }
        throw noResult(error, txHash, signer.accountId, receiverId);
      }
    });
    entry.latest = sent.catch(() => undefined);
    const response = await sent;
    return { response, outcome: toTxOutcome(response) };
  }

  /** The key's Account and latest write, created on its first write. */
  #entry(signer: AccountKey): { account: Account; latest: Promise<unknown> } {
    const key = `${signer.accountId} ${signer.keyPair.getPublicKey().toString()}`;
    let entry = this.#signers.get(key);
    if (entry === undefined) {
      entry = { account: new Account(signer.accountId, this.#send, new KeyPairSigner(signer.keyPair)), latest: Promise.resolve() };
      this.#signers.set(key, entry);
    }
    return entry;
  }

  /**
   * A view call at final finality, or at `at` when given: the block of that height, or optimistic
   * finality. The result is the contract's JSON, unchecked. Throws RangeError, reading nothing, for a
   * height that is not a safe integer, since near-api-js sends a block height as a JSON number.
   */
  async #view<T extends SerializedReturnValue>(
    contractId: string,
    method: string,
    args: Record<string, unknown>,
    at?: ReadAt,
  ): Promise<T | undefined> {
    const blockQuery = at === undefined ? FINAL : at === 'optimistic' ? OPTIMISTIC : { blockId: blockHeight(at) };
    return this.#read.callFunction<T>({ contractId, method, args, blockQuery });
  }
}

/** `height` as the number near-api-js takes for a block id; RangeError unless it is a safe integer. */
function blockHeight(height: bigint): number {
  const value = Number(height);
  if (height < 0n || !Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new RangeError(`${height} is not a block height`);
  return value;
}

/**
 * Whether the RPC ended a wait without an answer: near-api-js's error for an HTTP 408, which carries
 * the status as its cause, or the TIMEOUT_ERROR of a JSON-RPC error body.
 */
function timedOut(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof TransactionTimeoutError || (error instanceof Error && error.cause === 408);
}

/**
 * Whether a request failed without an answer from the RPC on the transaction: an HTTP 5xx status,
 * which near-api-js gives as its error's cause, or a request that fetch could not make or finish (a
 * TypeError).
 */
function failedRequest(error: unknown): boolean {
  if (!(error instanceof Error)) return false;
  return typeof error.cause === 'number' ? error.cause >= 500 : error instanceof TypeError;
}

/**
 * The error a write rejects with: an OutcomeUnknownError, `error` as its cause, when the request
 * timed out or failed, since the transaction (`txHash` when it is known) may have been sent; `error`
 * itself otherwise, a refusal of the RPC.
 */
function noResult(error: unknown, txHash: string | null, signerId: string, receiverId: string): unknown {
  const reason = timedOut(error) ? 'timeout' : failedRequest(error) ? transportReason(error) : null;
  if (reason === null) return error;
  const sent = txHash === null ? `a transaction from ${signerId} to ${receiverId} may have been sent` : `transaction ${txHash} from ${signerId} to ${receiverId} was sent`;
  return new OutcomeUnknownError(`${sent}, but the RPC gave no result (${reason}): it may still run`, txHash, reason, { cause: error });
}

/** The response's own failure, or null when it reports success. */
function failureOf(response: TransactionResponse): unknown {
  const { status } = response;
  return typeof status === 'object' && 'Failure' in status ? status.Failure : null;
}

/** A TransactionFailedError naming the transaction, the first failed receipt and the response's own failure. */
function failed(signerId: string, receiverId: string, response: TransactionResponse, outcome: TxOutcome): TransactionFailedError {
  const receipt = outcome.receipts.find((r) => r.failed);
  const failure = failureOf(response);
  const where = receipt === undefined ? '' : `: a receipt executed by ${receipt.executorId} failed`;
  const why = failure === null ? '' : `: ${JSON.stringify(failure)}`;
  return new TransactionFailedError(`transaction ${outcome.txHash} from ${signerId} to ${receiverId} failed${where}${why}`, outcome);
}
```

```typescript
 */

/**

}

/** The log line the pools contract writes for an event. */
export function eventLog(event: QuorumEvent): string {

}

/**

/** What every recorded write has: its signer, the public key it signed with, and its transaction hash. */

/** A write the fake received, with its arguments (public keys as strings). */

/** `Omit` applied to each member of a union. */
type Without<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? Omit<T, K> : never;
/** The arguments of a write, before the fake records it. */

/** The pools contract's limits on an `open` message (`target` and `terms`). */
const MAX_TARGET = 1000;
const MAX_TERMS_BYTES = 280;

function receipt(executorId: string, failed = false, logs: string[] = []): ReceiptOutcome {
  return { executorId, logs, failed, gasBurnt: 0n };
}

function isInteger(value: unknown, min: number, max: number): value is number {
  return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && (value as number) >= min && (value as number) <= max;
}

/** The fields of an `open` message, or null when `msg` is not one. */
function openFields(msg: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
```
