```typescript
/**
 * An in-memory SwarmChain. Tests set its state directly (accounts, keys, code, NEAR, the token's
 * registrations and balances, pools and seats, the final block) and read back `writes`, every write
 * it received, in order, with its signer, and `reads`, the block each balance or view read asked for.
 *
 * Writes act as the chain would, so that a command run twice sees its first run's effects:
 * - a write must be signed with a key its signer's account holds (else it throws an Error, as the RPC
 *   refuses it), and the signer must cover what it attaches plus `txFee` plus what `heldWhileRunning`
 *   asks (else an Error too);
 * - checks the contracts would make fail the write with a TransactionFailedError and change nothing:
 *   creating an account that exists or is not a direct sub-account of the signer, a NEAR transfer to
 *   a missing account, deploying over code or to an account that cannot hold its storage with the
 *   code added (`storagePricePerByte`), a registration deposit below `storageBalanceMin`, a
 *   token transfer from or to an unregistered account, of 0, to the sender itself, or beyond the
 *   sender's balance (a batch fails whole);
 * - otherwise the write takes effect and charges its signer `txFee` plus what it attaches (1
 *   yoctoNEAR per token call, a registration deposit for each account not registered yet), which
 *   goes to the receiver when it is one of the fake's accounts;
 * - `ft_transfer_call` opens a pool, as the contract does, when it sends a valid `open` message to a
 *   deployed pools contract, and is refused by its receiver otherwise (the receiver's receipt fails
 *   and the token keeps nothing). `onTransferCall` replaces that behaviour.
 *
 * Every write's outcome, a failed one's included, can be looked up with txOutcome, as can those
 * given to addOutcome. The fake burns no gas, never derives a pool's status from the block time, and
 * returns views as they were stored. `failWrite` makes a chosen write fail.
 */
export class FakeChain implements SwarmChain {
  readonly token: string;
  readonly poolsContract: string;
  /** What chainId returns. */
  nodeChainId = 'testnet';
  accounts = new Map<string, FakeAccount>();
  /** What getToken returns once the pools contract holds code; deployPools sets it to `token`. */
  poolsToken: string;
  /** What registrationDeposit returns, and the least deposit storageDeposits accepts. */
  storageBalanceMin = REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT;
  registered = new Set<string>();
  tokenBalances = new Map<string, bigint>();
  pools = new Map<number, PoolView>();
  /** Each pool's `get_seats` rows, in commit order. */
  seats = new Map<number, SeatView[]>();
  block: BlockInfo = { height: 1_000n, timestampMs: NOW_MS };
  /** The yoctoNEAR each write that runs charges its signer, standing in for gas. */
  txFee = 0n;
  /**
   * The yoctoNEAR a write needs its signer to hold while it runs, beyond what it attaches and `txFee`,
   * and leaves it: standing in for the gas a transaction buys upfront and gets back once it is done.
   * Nothing by default.
   */
  heldWhileRunning: (write: FakeWrite) => bigint = () => 0n;
  /**
   * The yoctoNEAR a byte of storage locks: NEAR's `storage_amount_per_byte`, 10^19 (1 NEAR per 100
   * kB). A deploy fails unless its account, once it has paid `txFee`, holds what its storage locks
   * with the code added to it.
   */
  storagePricePerByte = STORAGE_PRICE_PER_BYTE;
  writes: FakeWrite[] = [];
  /** Every read of a token balance or a pools view, in order, with the block height it asked for. */
  reads: FakeRead[] = [];
  /**
   * When set, answers every `ft_transfer_call` that its signer may send, instead of the fake's own
   * behaviour, which then changes no state; its outcome can be looked up with txOutcome.
   */
  onTransferCall?: (call: FakeTransferCall) => TransferCallResult | Promise<TransferCallResult>;

  readonly #outcomes = new Map<string, TxOutcome>();
  readonly #failures: Array<{ match: (write: FakeWrite) => boolean; error: Error | undefined }> = [];
  #transactions = 0;

  constructor(config: Pick<SwarmConfig, 'token' | 'poolsContract'> = { token: TOKEN, poolsContract: POOLS }) {
    this.token = config.token;
    this.poolsContract = config.poolsContract;
    this.poolsToken = config.token;
  }

  /** Adds (or replaces) an account; it holds nothing, uses no storage and has no key unless given. */
  addAccount(
    accountId: string,
    state: { balance?: bigint; hasCode?: boolean; storageUsage?: bigint; publicKeys?: PublicKey[] } = {},
  ): FakeAccount {
    const account: FakeAccount = {
      balance: state.balance ?? 0n,
      hasCode: state.hasCode ?? false,
      storageUsage: state.storageUsage ?? 0n,
      keys: new Set((state.publicKeys ?? []).map(String)),
    };
    this.accounts.set(accountId, account);
    return account;
  }

  /** Adds an account holding `balance` yoctoNEAR with a fresh full-access key, and returns that key. */
  addSigner(accountId: string, balance = 0n): AccountKey {
    const keyPair = KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519');
    this.addAccount(accountId, { balance, publicKeys: [keyPair.getPublicKey()] });
    return { accountId, keyPair };
  }

  /** Registers the account on the token and sets its token balance. */
  register(accountId: string, balance = 0n): void {
    this.registered.add(accountId);
    this.tokenBalances.set(accountId, balance);
  }

  setPool(pool: PoolView): void {
    this.pools.set(pool.id, pool);
  }

  /** Makes txOutcome(outcome.txHash, signerId) return `outcome`. */
  addOutcome(signerId: string, outcome: TxOutcome): void {
    this.#outcomes.set(`${signerId} ${outcome.txHash}`, outcome);
  }

  /**
   * Makes the first later write for which `match` is true fail: it is recorded, changes nothing, and
   * throws `error`, by default a TransactionFailedError whose outcome has the receiver's receipt
   * failed. Each call arms one failure.
   */
  failWrite(match: (write: FakeWrite) => boolean, error?: Error): void {
    this.#failures.push({ match, error });
  }

  async chainId(): Promise<string> {
    return this.nodeChainId;
  }

  async account(accountId: string): Promise<AccountState | null> {
    const account = this.accounts.get(accountId);
    return account === undefined ? null : { balance: account.balance, hasCode: account.hasCode, storageUsage: account.storageUsage };
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<string> {
    if (this.accounts.get(this.poolsContract)?.hasCode !== true) {
      throw new Error(`FakeChain: ${this.poolsContract} holds no contract`);
    }
    return this.poolsToken;
  }

  async registrationDeposit(): Promise<bigint> {
    return this.storageBalanceMin;
  }

  async isRegistered(accountId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.registered.has(accountId);
  }

  async ftBalanceOf(accountId: string, atHeight?: bigint): Promise<bigint> {
    this.#recordRead('ftBalanceOf', [accountId], atHeight);
    return this.tokenBalances.get(accountId) ?? 0n;
  }

  async getPool(poolId: number): Promise<PoolView | null> {
    this.#recordRead('getPool', [poolId], undefined);
    return this.pools.get(poolId) ?? null;
  }

  async listPools(from: number, limit: number, at?: ReadAt): Promise<PoolView[]> {
    this.#recordRead('listPools', [from, limit], at);
    return [...this.pools.values()]
      .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)
      .filter((pool) => pool.id >= from)
      .slice(0, Math.min(limit, MAX_PAGE));
  }

  async getSeats(poolId: number, from: number, limit: number, atHeight?: bigint): Promise<SeatView[]> {
    this.#recordRead('getSeats', [poolId, from, limit], atHeight);
    return (this.seats.get(poolId) ?? []).slice(from, from + Math.min(limit, MAX_PAGE));
  }

  #recordRead(method: FakeRead['method'], args: FakeRead['args'], at: ReadAt | undefined): void {
    this.reads.push({ method, args, atHeight: at ?? null });
  }

  async finalBlock(): Promise<BlockInfo> {
    return this.block;
  }

  async txOutcome(txHash: string, signerId: string): Promise<TxOutcome | null> {
    return this.#outcomes.get(`${signerId} ${txHash}`) ?? null;
  }

  async createAccount(signer: AccountKey, account: NewAccount): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    const { accountId, balance } = account;
    const write = this.#send(signer, { kind: 'createAccount', accountId, balance, publicKeys: account.publicKeys.map(String) }, balance);
    if (this.accounts.has(accountId)) throw this.#failure(write, `${accountId} exists already`);
    if (!isSubAccount(accountId, signer.accountId)) {
      throw this.#failure(write, `${signer.accountId} cannot create ${accountId}, which is not its direct sub-account`);
    }
    this.addAccount(accountId, { publicKeys: account.publicKeys });
    this.#pay(write, accountId, balance);
    return this.#outcome(write, [receipt(accountId)]);
  }

  async transferNear(signer: AccountKey, receiverId: string, amount: bigint): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    const write = this.#send(signer, { kind: 'transferNear', receiverId, amount }, amount);
    if (!this.accounts.has(receiverId)) throw this.#failure(write, `${receiverId} does not exist`);
    this.#pay(write, receiverId, amount);
    return this.#outcome(write, [receipt(receiverId)]);
  }

  async deployPools(signer: AccountKey, code: Uint8Array): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    const write = this.#send(signer, { kind: 'deployPools', code }, 0n);
    const account = this.accounts.get(signer.accountId);
    if (account === undefined || account.hasCode) throw this.#failure(write, `${signer.accountId} holds a contract already`);
    const storage = account.storageUsage + BigInt(code.length);
    const locked = storage * this.storagePricePerByte;
    if (account.balance - this.txFee < locked) {
      throw this.#failure(write, `${signer.accountId} cannot hold the ${locked} yoctoNEAR its storage locks with the code`);
    }
    account.hasCode = true;
    account.storageUsage = storage;
    if (signer.accountId === this.poolsContract) this.poolsToken = this.token;
    this.#pay(write, signer.accountId, 0n);
    return this.#outcome(write, [receipt(signer.accountId)]);
  }

  async storageDeposits(signer: AccountKey, accountIds: readonly string[], deposit: bigint): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    assertBatchSize(accountIds.length);
    const attached = deposit * BigInt(accountIds.length);
    const write = this.#send(signer, { kind: 'storageDeposits', accountIds: [...accountIds], deposit }, attached);
    if (deposit < this.storageBalanceMin) throw this.#failure(write, `a deposit of ${deposit} is below the minimum`);
    let added = 0n;
    for (const id of accountIds) {
      if (this.registered.has(id)) continue;
      this.register(id);
      added += 1n;
    }
    this.#pay(write, this.token, deposit * added);
    return this.#outcome(write, [receipt(this.token)]);
  }

  async ftTransfers(signer: AccountKey, transfers: readonly TokenTransfer[]): Promise<TxOutcome> {
    assertBatchSize(transfers.length);
    const copies = transfers.map((transfer) => ({ ...transfer }));
    const write = this.#send(signer, { kind: 'ftTransfers', transfers: copies }, ONE_YOCTO * BigInt(transfers.length));
    const problem = this.#transferProblem(signer.accountId, transfers);
    if (problem !== null) throw this.#failure(write, problem);
    for (const { receiverId, amount } of transfers) this.#moveTokens(signer.accountId, receiverId, amount);
    this.#pay(write, this.token, ONE_YOCTO * BigInt(transfers.length));
    return this.#outcome(write, [receipt(this.token)]);
  }

  async ftTransferCall(signer: AccountKey, call: TransferCall): Promise<TransferCallResult> {
    const write = this.#send(signer, { kind: 'ftTransferCall' as const, ...call }, ONE_YOCTO);
    if (this.onTransferCall !== undefined) {
      const result = await this.onTransferCall(write);
      this.addOutcome(signer.accountId, result.outcome);
      return result;
    }
    const problem = this.#transferProblem(signer.accountId, [call]);
    if (problem !== null) throw this.#failure(write, problem);
    this.#pay(write, this.token, ONE_YOCTO);
    const pool = this.#openedPool(signer.accountId, call);
    if (pool === null) {
      return { outcome: this.#outcome(write, [receipt(this.token), receipt(call.receiverId, true), receipt(this.token)]), used: 0n };
    }
    this.#moveTokens(signer.accountId, call.receiverId, call.amount);
    this.setPool(pool);
    const { id, seller, seat_price, target, deadline_ms, bonus, terms } = pool;
    const opened = eventLog({ event: 'pool_opened', data: { pool_id: id, seller, seat_price, target, deadline_ms, bonus, terms } });
    const receipts = [receipt(this.token), receipt(call.receiverId, false, [opened]), receipt(this.token)];
    return { outcome: this.#outcome(write, receipts), used: call.amount };
  }

  /**
   * Records a write, then lets it through or throws: an armed failure first, then the RPC's checks on
   * its signer (account, key, NEAR to cover `attached` and the fee).
   */
  #send<A extends WriteArgs>(signer: AccountKey, args: A, attached: bigint): A & WriteBase {
    this.#transactions += 1;
    const txHash = baseEncode(createHash('sha256').update(`fake transaction ${this.#transactions}`).digest());
    const publicKey = signer.keyPair.getPublicKey().toString();
    const write = { ...args, signer: signer.accountId, publicKey, txHash };
    this.writes.push(write);
    const armed = this.#failures.findIndex((failure) => failure.match(write));
    if (armed !== -1) {
      const [failure] = this.#failures.splice(armed, 1);
      throw failure?.error ?? this.#failure(write, 'made to fail by failWrite');
    }
    const account = this.accounts.get(signer.accountId);
    if (account === undefined) throw new Error(`FakeChain: ${signer.accountId} does not exist`);
    if (!account.keys.has(publicKey)) throw new Error(`FakeChain: ${signer.accountId} has no access key ${publicKey}`);
    const needed = attached + this.txFee + this.heldWhileRunning(write);
    if (account.balance < needed) throw new Error(`FakeChain: ${signer.accountId} cannot pay ${needed} yoctoNEAR`);
    return write;
  }

  /** Charges the signer the fee and `attached`, which goes to `receiverId` if the fake holds it. */
  #pay(write: FakeWrite, receiverId: string, attached: bigint): void {
    const signer = this.accounts.get(write.signer);
    if (signer !== undefined) signer.balance -= attached + this.txFee;
    const receiver = this.accounts.get(receiverId);
    if (receiver !== undefined) receiver.balance += attached;
  }

  /** The write's outcome: its transaction at the signer, then `receipts`. Recorded for txOutcome. */
  #outcome(write: FakeWrite, receipts: ReceiptOutcome[]): TxOutcome {
    const outcome = { txHash: write.txHash, receipts: [receipt(write.signer), ...receipts] };
    this.addOutcome(write.signer, outcome);
    return outcome;
  }

  /** A TransactionFailedError for the write, whose outcome has its receiver's receipt failed. */
  #failure(write: FakeWrite, why: string): TransactionFailedError {
    const receiver = receiverOf(write, this.token);
    const outcome = this.#outcome(write, [receipt(receiver, true)]);
    return new TransactionFailedError(`FakeChain: ${write.kind} ${write.txHash} from ${write.signer} failed: ${why}`, outcome);
  }

  /** Why the token would refuse these transfers from `sender`, or null. */
  #transferProblem(sender: string, transfers: readonly TokenTransfer[]): string | null {
    if (!this.registered.has(sender)) return `${sender} is not registered on the token`;
    let total = 0n;
    for (const { receiverId, amount } of transfers) {
      if (!this.registered.has(receiverId)) return `${receiverId} is not registered on the token`;
      if (receiverId === sender) return `${sender} cannot send tokens to itself`;
      if (amount <= 0n) return 'a token transfer must be of a positive amount';
      total += amount;
    }
    const balance = this.tokenBalances.get(sender) ?? 0n;
    return total > balance ? `${sender} holds ${balance}, not ${total}` : null;
  }

  #moveTokens(from: string, to: string, amount: bigint): void {
    this.tokenBalances.set(from, (this.tokenBalances.get(from) ?? 0n) - amount);
    this.tokenBalances.set(to, (this.tokenBalances.get(to) ?? 0n) + amount);
  }

  /** The pool a call opens, as the pools contract checks its `open` message; null when it refuses. */
  #openedPool(seller: string, call: TransferCall): PoolView | null {
    if (call.receiverId !== this.poolsContract || this.accounts.get(call.receiverId)?.hasCode !== true) return null;
    const open = openFields(call.msg);
    if (open === null) return null;
    const { seat_price, target, deadline_ms, max_seats_per_buyer = null, terms } = open;
    const price = parseAmount(seat_price);
    if (price === null || price === 0n || !isInteger(target, 1, MAX_TARGET)) return null;
    if (!isInteger(deadline_ms, this.block.timestampMs + 1, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) return null;
    if (typeof terms !== 'string' || Buffer.byteLength(terms) > MAX_TERMS_BYTES) return null;
    if (max_seats_per_buyer !== null && !isInteger(max_seats_per_buyer, 1, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) return null;
    return poolView({
      id: Math.max(-1, ...this.pools.keys()) + 1,
      seller,
      seat_price: price.toString(),
      target,
      deadline_ms,
      bonus: call.amount.toString(),
      max_seats_per_buyer,
      terms,
    });
  }
}

/** The account a write's transaction is sent to. */
function receiverOf(write: FakeWrite, token: string): string {
  switch (write.kind) {
    case 'createAccount':
      return write.accountId;
    case 'transferNear':
      return write.receiverId;
    case 'deployPools':
      return write.signer;
    default:
      return token;
  }
}
```

### Task 8: Setup and the env file writers

`runSetup(config, { chain, log })` prepares every account of the system (section 7.2). It is
idempotent: a run that finds everything in place sends nothing and logs `nothing to do`. It first
reads and checks everything, and sends nothing and writes no key file until every check has passed:

- the RPC's chain (`checkChain`; the command line checks it too, but setup signs, and a caller can
  run it without the command line);
- the parent's key file and account;
- each account's state, key file and registration on the token. A missing account that setup does
  not create (one outside the parent) stops it, as does an existing account without a key file; the
  pools contract needs none once it holds code, since it never signs again. The key files follow
  near-cli's layout, `<folder>/testnet/<account>.json` (`sandbox/` on a local sandbox), and the
  relayer's keys are in its key folder, `<folder>/testnet/<account>/`, one file per key;
- the pools contract's `get_token` when it holds code (it must be `QUORUM_TOKEN_ACCOUNT`, since a
  contract's token is set once), and `QUORUM_POOLS_WASM` when it must be deployed;
- the token balance of each account with a token amount, which gives step 5's transfers. An account
  that does not exist or is not registered lacks its whole amount, and its balance is not read;
- that the parent holds, free of its storage (`freeBalance`), what steps 1, 2 and 4 send from it plus
  a margin for gas: 0.1 NEAR, plus 0.008 NEAR for each account it creates (NEAR keeps a fixed fee
  for each creation), plus 0.02 NEAR for each call of the largest batch it signs (20 Tgas bought
  upfront at 0.001 NEAR per Tgas, refunded after), that batch being the registrations, or the token
  top-ups when the funding account is the parent. The check is made only when the parent sends NEAR
  or signs a batch. Its failure is a `ShortfallError` (`near_shortfall`) whose message gives the
  parent's ID, what it holds free, what setup sends, the margin and its parts, and the shortfall.
  With the defaults, a first setup sends 8.58 NEAR (the 25 accounts' balances and 24 registrations)
  and keeps a margin of 0.5 NEAR.

Then it takes five steps, in order:

1. It creates each missing sub-account of the parent with its NEAR target as its balance. Each new
   key is written to its key file before the transaction is sent; a key that an interrupted run left
   is reused (an empty key file counts as missing), and a relayer key folder left part-written is
   completed. The relayer gets `QUORUM_RELAYER_KEY_COUNT` keys in its key folder, the first of them
   also in its key file.
2. It tops each existing account up to its NEAR target from the parent, once it holds less than 90%
   of it; a funding account that is the parent is never topped up. Once the pools contract holds
   code, it goes instead by its NEAR free of storage, and is topped up back to
   `QUORUM_POOLS_FREE_NEAR` free once less than 90% of that is free, since the records it keeps for
   each pool and buyer lock more of its balance as they grow. The 90% threshold leaves a run that
   follows another with nothing to send, although every transaction an account signs burns a little
   of its NEAR.
3. It deploys the pools contract and initialises it with the configured token in the same
   transaction, when the account holds no code; after the top-ups, so that a pools account holding
   less than its code locks has been topped up first.
4. It registers on the token (`storage_deposit`, paid by the parent) each of the funding account,
   the pools contract, the provider and the buyers that is not registered yet, at most 10 per
   transaction, with the deposit read from the token's `storage_balance_bounds`.
5. It tops the provider and each buyer up to its token amount from the funding account, at most 10
   per transaction, once it has checked that the funding account covers them all; if not, it makes
   none of them and throws a `ShortfallError` (`token_shortfall`) naming the funding account and the
   shortfall in base units. Then it clears the MCP server's spend total, unless the spend file
   reads 0 already, and never writes over a file that is not a spend file.

Each action is logged as it is taken (each transaction with its hash, each key file written) and
returned in the report; no line or error holds a key. A failed write throws its error; a write that
got no result (`OutcomeUnknownError`) stops setup with the advice that it can be run again once that
transaction is final, and that it then sends only what is still missing (`rerunAdvice`).

The env file writers give the gateway and the MCP server a `.env` written from the swarm's
configuration, so that the three apps share one value of each shared variable (section 7.6).
`gatewayEnvText` writes the shared values (network, RPC URL, gateway URL, parent, token, pools
account), the relayer and provider accounts, every relayer key, a new credential key
(`newCredentialJwk`: an Ed25519 private JWK holding only `kty`, `crv`, `x` and `d`), the commit gas
bounds and the block time; `mcpEnvText` writes the shared values, the block time, the buyer's
payment life, its account, the key files' folder, a spend cap equal to the buyer budget, and the
spend file. Each text is read back with Node's own env file parser (`parseEnv`, which
`process.loadEnvFile` uses), and a value that would not read back as written, such as a URL holding
`#`, is refused with a `RangeError` that names the variable, never the value. `writeEnvFile` creates
a new file readable by its owner only (flag `wx`, mode `0o600`) and never writes over one
(`EnvFileExistsError`). On Windows, which ignores the mode, `aclNotice` gives the `icacls` command
that leaves the current user alone with access to the file. `envFilePath('gateway' | 'mcp')` is
`apps/<app>/.env`, resolved from the module's own location. `test/env-files.test.ts` reads the
gateway's file back with the gateway's own loader, `apps/gateway/src/config.ts`.

`test/env-files.test.ts` is not final here: Task 13 adds the import of the MCP server's loader
(`loadMcpConfig` and `McpConfig` from `../../mcp/src/config.ts`), `mcpEnvText` and `writeMcpEnv` in
the import list, and the `mcpEnvText` and `writeMcpEnv` describe blocks, both of which read the file
with that loader. Until then, from this task to Task 12, `mcpEnvText` and `writeMcpEnv` have no test.
One test of this file, the file mode's, is skipped on Windows.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/swarm/src/setup.ts`, `apps/swarm/src/env-files.ts`
- Test: `apps/swarm/test/setup.test.ts`, `apps/swarm/test/env-files.test.ts`

`apps/swarm/test/setup.test.ts`:

```typescript
import { mkdir, mkdtemp, readdir, readFile, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import {
  ConfigError,
  folderKeyPath,
  keyFilePath,
  keyFolderPath,
  readKeyFile,
  readKeyFolder,
  readSpendFile,
  SpendFileError,
  writeKeyFile,
  writeSpendFile,
} from '@quorum-on-near/buyer';
import { KeyPair } from 'near-api-js';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { scriptedBuyerIds } from '../src/accounts.ts';
import type { SwarmConfig } from '../src/config.ts';
import { OutcomeUnknownError } from '../src/chain.ts';
import { runSetup, SetupError, ShortfallError, type SetupProblem, type SetupReport } from '../src/setup.ts';
import { FakeChain, NEAR, PARENT, POOLS, PROVIDER, REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT, testConfig, type FakeWrite } from './fake-chain.ts';

const FUNDING = `funding.${PARENT}`;
const RELAYER = `relay.${PARENT}`;
const MCP = `buyer-llm.${PARENT}`;
const BUYERS = [...scriptedBuyerIds(PARENT), MCP];
/** A wasm module's first eight bytes: what setup deploys, read from QUORUM_POOLS_WASM. */
const WASM = new Uint8Array([0x00, 0x61, 0x73, 0x6d, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]);
const MILLINEAR = NEAR / 1000n;
/**
 * What a first setup sends from the parent with the defaults: the funding account 0.5 NEAR, the
 * pools contract 3.5, the relayer 3, the provider 0.5, 21 buyers 0.05 each (8.55 NEAR), and 24
 * registrations of 0.00125 NEAR (0.03 NEAR).
 */
const FIRST_RUN_SENDS = 8_580n * MILLINEAR;
/**
 * What a first setup keeps for gas beyond that: 0.1 NEAR, plus 0.008 NEAR for each of the 25
 * accounts it creates (0.2 NEAR), plus the 0.2 NEAR its batches of 10 registrations hold while they
 * run (10 calls of 20 Tgas at 0.001 NEAR per Tgas).
 */
const FIRST_RUN_GAS = 500n * MILLINEAR;
const FIRST_RUN_NEAR = FIRST_RUN_SENDS + FIRST_RUN_GAS;
/** What each batched call holds while it runs: 20 Tgas bought at 0.001 NEAR per Tgas. */
const CALL_GAS_HELD = 20n * MILLINEAR;
/** What the provider and the 21 buyers are topped up to on the token: 22 × 10,000 base units. */
const FIRST_RUN_TOKENS = 220_000n;

let dir: string;

beforeEach(async () => {
  dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'quorum-setup-'));
  await writeFile(join(dir, 'quorum_pools.wasm'), WASM);
});

afterEach(async () => {
  await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

/** A setup world: a fake chain holding the parent and its key file, and the lines setup logs. */
interface World {
  config: SwarmConfig;
  chain: FakeChain;
  parentKey: KeyPair;
  lines: string[];
  run(): Promise<SetupReport>;
}

/** A chain holding only the parent, with `parentNear`, and the parent's key file in the temp folder. */
async function world(opts: { parentNear?: bigint; config?: Partial<SwarmConfig> } = {}): Promise<World> {
  const config = testConfig({
    credentialsDir: join(dir, 'keys'),
    spendFile: join(dir, 'mcp-spend.json'),
    poolsWasm: join(dir, 'quorum_pools.wasm'),
    ...opts.config,
  });
  const chain = new FakeChain(config);
  const { keyPair: parentKey } = chain.addSigner(PARENT, opts.parentNear ?? 100n * NEAR);
  await writeKeyFile(keyFile(config, PARENT), PARENT, parentKey);
  const lines: string[] = [];
  return { config, chain, parentKey, lines, run: () => runSetup(config, { chain, log: (line) => lines.push(line) }) };
}

/** A world in which setup has run to the end: the first run, the funding account filled, the second run. */
async function readyWorld(opts: { config?: Partial<SwarmConfig> } = {}): Promise<World> {
  const w = await world(opts);
  await expect(w.run()).rejects.toThrow(ShortfallError);
  w.chain.tokenBalances.set(w.config.funding, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
  await w.run();
  w.chain.writes = [];
  w.lines.length = 0;
  return w;
}

function keyFile(config: SwarmConfig, accountId: string): string {
  return keyFilePath(config.credentialsDir, config.network, accountId);
}

/** The error `promise` rejects with; fails the test if it resolves. */
async function rejection(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
  try {
    await promise;
  } catch (error) {
    return error;
  }
  throw new Error('the promise resolved');
}

/** Checks that setup stopped with `problem`, in a message that names `named`. */
function expectSetupError(error: unknown, problem: SetupProblem, named: string): void {
  expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(SetupError);
  expect((error as SetupError).problem).toBe(problem);
  expect((error as SetupError).message).toContain(named);
}

/** The writes of one kind, in order. */
function writesOf<K extends FakeWrite['kind']>(chain: FakeChain, kind: K): Extract<FakeWrite, { kind: K }>[] {
  return chain.writes.filter((write): write is Extract<FakeWrite, { kind: K }> => write.kind === kind);
}

describe('runSetup on a chain that holds only the parent', () => {
  it('creates every account under the parent with its NEAR target as its balance, in order', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await rejection(w.run());
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount').map(({ signer, accountId, balance }) => [signer, accountId, balance])).toEqual([
      [PARENT, FUNDING, 500n * MILLINEAR],
      [PARENT, POOLS, 3_500n * MILLINEAR],
      [PARENT, RELAYER, 3_000n * MILLINEAR],
      [PARENT, PROVIDER, 500n * MILLINEAR],
      ...BUYERS.map((id) => [PARENT, id, 50n * MILLINEAR]),
    ]);
  });

  it('writes each new key to its key file, for the account the creation gives that key', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await rejection(w.run());
    for (const { accountId, publicKeys } of writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount')) {
      if (accountId === RELAYER) continue;
      const stored = JSON.parse(await readFile(keyFile(w.config, accountId), 'utf8')) as Record<string, string>;
      expect(stored.account_id).toBe(accountId);
      expect(publicKeys).toEqual([stored.public_key]);
    }
  });

  it('reports each transaction with its hash and each key file it writes, as it goes', async () => {
    const w = await world({ config: { relayerKeyCount: 2 } });
    await rejection(w.run());
    expect(w.chain.writes).toHaveLength(29);
    for (const write of w.chain.writes) {
      expect(w.lines.filter((line) => line.includes(write.txHash))).toHaveLength(1);
    }
    const files = (await readdir(w.config.credentialsDir, { recursive: true }))
      .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.json'))
      .map((name) => join(w.config.credentialsDir, name))
      .filter((path) => path !== keyFile(w.config, PARENT));
    expect(files).toHaveLength(24 + 2 + 1);
    for (const path of files) expect(w.lines.filter((line) => line.endsWith(path))).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(w.lines).toHaveLength(29 + 27);
  });

  it("gives the relayer QUORUM_RELAYER_KEY_COUNT keys in its key folder, and the first in the relayer's key file", async () => {
    const w = await world({ config: { relayerKeyCount: 3 } });
    await rejection(w.run());
    const [relayer] = writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount').filter((write) => write.accountId === RELAYER);
    const folderKeys = await readKeyFolder(keyFolderPath(w.config.credentialsDir, w.config.network, RELAYER));
    expect(relayer?.publicKeys).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(new Set(relayer?.publicKeys)).toEqual(new Set(folderKeys.map((key) => key.getPublicKey().toString())));
    const relayerFile = await readKeyFile(keyFile(w.config, RELAYER));
    expect(relayer?.publicKeys[0]).toBe(relayerFile.getPublicKey().toString());
  });

  it('deploys the pools contract from QUORUM_POOLS_WASM, signed by the pools account', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await rejection(w.run());
    const deploys = writesOf(w.chain, 'deployPools');
    expect(deploys.map(({ signer, code }) => [signer, [...code]])).toEqual([[POOLS, [...WASM]]]);
  });

  it('registers the funding account, the pools contract, the provider and each buyer, 10 at most per transaction', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await rejection(w.run());
    const deposits = writesOf(w.chain, 'storageDeposits');
    expect(deposits.map(({ signer, deposit }) => [signer, deposit])).toEqual([
      [PARENT, REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT],
      [PARENT, REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT],
      [PARENT, REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT],
    ]);
    expect(deposits.map((write) => write.accountIds)).toEqual([
      [FUNDING, POOLS, PROVIDER, ...BUYERS.slice(0, 7)],
      BUYERS.slice(7, 17),
      BUYERS.slice(17),
    ]);
    expect(w.chain.registered.has(RELAYER)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('then stops, naming the funding account and its token shortfall, and makes none of the top-ups', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expectSetupError(error, 'token_shortfall', FUNDING);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ShortfallError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ account: FUNDING, shortfall: FIRST_RUN_TOKENS });
    expect((error as Error).message).toContain('220000');
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'ftTransfers')).toEqual([]);
    expect(w.chain.writes.map((write) => write.kind)).toEqual([
      ...Array<string>(25).fill('createAccount'),
      'deployPools',
      'storageDeposits',
      'storageDeposits',
      'storageDeposits',
    ]);
  });
});

describe('runSetup once the funding account holds the tokens', () => {
  it('tops the provider and each buyer up from the funding account, 10 at most per transaction', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await rejection(w.run());
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS + 5n);
    w.chain.writes = [];
    await w.run();
    const transfers = writesOf(w.chain, 'ftTransfers');
    expect(transfers.map((write) => write.signer)).toEqual([FUNDING, FUNDING, FUNDING]);
    expect(transfers.map((write) => write.transfers)).toEqual([
      [PROVIDER, ...BUYERS.slice(0, 9)].map((receiverId) => ({ receiverId, amount: 10_000n })),
      BUYERS.slice(9, 19).map((receiverId) => ({ receiverId, amount: 10_000n })),
      BUYERS.slice(19).map((receiverId) => ({ receiverId, amount: 10_000n })),
    ]);
    expect(w.chain.tokenBalances.get(FUNDING)).toBe(5n);
    expect(w.chain.writes.map((write) => write.kind)).toEqual(['ftTransfers', 'ftTransfers', 'ftTransfers']);
  });

  it("clears the MCP server's spend total", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await writeSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP, 4_000n);
    await rejection(w.run());
    expect(await readSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP)).toBe(4_000n);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
    await w.run();
    expect(await readSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP)).toBe(0n);
  });

  it('reports each transaction it sent with its hash, and each file it wrote, and returns the same lines', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await writeSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP, 4_000n);
    await rejection(w.run());
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
    w.lines.length = 0;
    const report = await w.run();
    expect(report.actions).toEqual(w.lines);
    expect(w.lines).toHaveLength(4);
    for (const write of w.chain.writes.slice(-3)) {
      expect(w.lines.filter((line) => line.includes(write.txHash))).toHaveLength(1);
    }
    expect(w.lines.filter((line) => line.includes(w.config.spendFile) && line.includes(MCP))).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('then has nothing to do: a third run reads only, and says so', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    const report = await w.run();
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    expect(report.actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(w.lines).toEqual(['nothing to do']);
  });
});

describe('runSetup refuses before sending anything', () => {
  /** Runs setup and checks that it stopped with `problem`, naming `named`, and that it sent and wrote nothing. */
  async function expectRefusal(w: World, problem: SetupProblem, named: string): Promise<unknown> {
    const before = await readdir(dir, { recursive: true });
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expectSetupError(error, problem, named);
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    expect(w.lines).toEqual([]);
    expect(await readdir(dir, { recursive: true })).toEqual(before);
    return error;
  }

  it('when the RPC serves another chain than QUORUM_NETWORK names, with a ConfigError as the command line gives', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    w.chain.nodeChainId = 'mainnet';
    const before = await readdir(dir, { recursive: true });
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ConfigError);
    expect((error as ConfigError).problems).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('"mainnet"')]);
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    expect(w.lines).toEqual([]);
    expect(await readdir(dir, { recursive: true })).toEqual(before);
  });

  it("when the parent's key file is missing", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    await rm(keyFile(w.config, PARENT));
    await expectRefusal(w, 'missing_key', PARENT);
  });

  it('when the parent account does not exist', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    w.chain.accounts.delete(PARENT);
    await expectRefusal(w, 'missing_account', PARENT);
  });

  it('when the parent cannot pay for what setup sends, naming it and the NEAR it lacks', async () => {
    const w = await world({ parentNear: FIRST_RUN_NEAR - 10n * MILLINEAR });
    const error = await expectRefusal(w, 'near_shortfall', PARENT);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ShortfallError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ account: PARENT, shortfall: 10n * MILLINEAR });
    expect((error as Error).message).toContain('0.01 NEAR');
  });

  it('when an account it would sign for exists without a key file', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    w.chain.addAccount(PROVIDER, { balance: NEAR });
    await expectRefusal(w, 'missing_key', PROVIDER);
  });

  it('when the relayer exists without its key folder', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const { keyPair } = w.chain.addSigner(RELAYER, 3n * NEAR);
    await writeKeyFile(keyFile(w.config, RELAYER), RELAYER, keyPair);
    await expectRefusal(w, 'missing_key', RELAYER);
  });

  it('when a funding account outside the parent does not exist: setup never creates it', async () => {
    const w = await world({ config: { funding: 'treasury.testnet' } });
    await expectRefusal(w, 'missing_account', 'treasury.testnet');
  });

  it('when a funding account outside the parent has no key file', async () => {
    const w = await world({ config: { funding: 'treasury.testnet' } });
    w.chain.addSigner('treasury.testnet', NEAR);
    await expectRefusal(w, 'missing_key', 'treasury.testnet');
  });

  it('when the pools contract was initialised with another token', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    w.chain.addAccount(POOLS, { balance: 3n * NEAR, hasCode: true });
    w.chain.poolsToken = 'other-token.testnet';
    const error = await expectRefusal(w, 'wrong_token', POOLS);
    expect((error as Error).message).toContain('other-token.testnet');
  });

  it('when the pools contract must be deployed but QUORUM_POOLS_WASM is not set', async () => {
    const w = await world({ config: { poolsWasm: null } });
    await expectRefusal(w, 'missing_wasm', 'QUORUM_POOLS_WASM');
  });

  it('when the pools account exists without code and without a key file to deploy with', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    w.chain.addAccount(POOLS, { balance: 3n * NEAR });
    await expectRefusal(w, 'missing_key', POOLS);
  });
});

describe('the NEAR pre-check', () => {
  it('lets setup run when the parent holds exactly what it sends plus its gas margin', async () => {
    const w = await world({ parentNear: FIRST_RUN_NEAR });
    expect(await rejection(w.run())).toMatchObject({ problem: 'token_shortfall' });
    expect(w.chain.accounts.get(PARENT)?.balance).toBe(FIRST_RUN_GAS);
  });

  it('keeps enough for a first setup whose transactions burn gas and hold the gas of each call while they run', async () => {
    const w = await world({ parentNear: FIRST_RUN_NEAR });
    // An account creation alone costs about 0.00707 NEAR.
    w.chain.txFee = 8n * MILLINEAR;
    w.chain.heldWhileRunning = (write) => (write.kind === 'storageDeposits' ? BigInt(write.accountIds.length) * CALL_GAS_HELD : 0n);
    expect(await rejection(w.run())).toMatchObject({ problem: 'token_shortfall' });
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'storageDeposits')).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  it('refuses a parent that holds what setup sends plus only 0.1 NEAR, too little for the gas of a first setup', async () => {
    const w = await world({ parentNear: FIRST_RUN_SENDS + 100n * MILLINEAR });
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ problem: 'near_shortfall', account: PARENT, shortfall: 400n * MILLINEAR });
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('says what the gas margin is made of', async () => {
    const w = await world({ parentNear: FIRST_RUN_NEAR - 1n });
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ problem: 'near_shortfall', shortfall: 1n });
    expect((error as Error).message).toContain(
      'setup sends 8.58 NEAR from it and keeps 0.5 NEAR for gas (0.1 NEAR, plus 0.008 NEAR for each of the 25 accounts ' +
        'it creates, plus 0.2 NEAR its largest batch of 10 calls buys upfront, refunded after)',
    );
  });

  it('grows the margin with the accounts to create and the calls of the largest batch', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    for (const id of BUYERS.slice(0, 3)) {
      w.chain.accounts.delete(id);
      w.chain.registered.delete(id);
      w.chain.tokenBalances.delete(id);
    }
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, 30_000n);
    // Sent: 3 × 0.05 NEAR and 3 registrations. Kept: 0.1 NEAR, 3 × 0.008 NEAR and one batch of 3 calls.
    const needed = 150n * MILLINEAR + 3n * REGISTRATION_DEPOSIT + 100n * MILLINEAR + 24n * MILLINEAR + 3n * CALL_GAS_HELD;
    w.chain.accounts.get(PARENT)!.balance = needed - 1n;
    expect(await rejection(w.run())).toMatchObject({ problem: 'near_shortfall', shortfall: 1n });
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    w.chain.accounts.get(PARENT)!.balance = needed;
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount').map((write) => write.accountId)).toEqual(BUYERS.slice(0, 3));
  });

  it('keeps the gas of the token top-ups too when the parent is the funding account, even if it sends no NEAR', async () => {
    const w = await world({ config: { funding: PARENT } });
    w.chain.register(PARENT, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
    await w.run();
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(BUYERS[0]!, 0n);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(PARENT, 10_000n);
    w.chain.writes = [];
    // One batch of one ft_transfer.
    w.chain.accounts.get(PARENT)!.balance = 100n * MILLINEAR + CALL_GAS_HELD - 1n;
    expect(await rejection(w.run())).toMatchObject({ problem: 'near_shortfall', shortfall: 1n });
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    w.chain.accounts.get(PARENT)!.balance = 100n * MILLINEAR + CALL_GAS_HELD;
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'ftTransfers').map((write) => write.transfers)).toEqual([[{ receiverId: BUYERS[0], amount: 10_000n }]]);
  });

  it("compares what setup sends with the parent's NEAR free of its storage", async () => {
    const w = await world({ parentNear: FIRST_RUN_NEAR });
    // 1,000 bytes lock 0.01 NEAR of the parent's balance.
    w.chain.accounts.get(PARENT)!.storageUsage = 1_000n;
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ problem: 'near_shortfall', account: PARENT, shortfall: 10n * MILLINEAR });
    expect((error as Error).message).toContain(`the parent account ${PARENT} holds 9.07 NEAR free of its storage, but setup sends 8.58 NEAR`);
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('asks for nothing when setup sends nothing from the parent', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    w.chain.accounts.get(PARENT)!.balance = 0n;
    await w.run();
    expect(w.lines).toEqual(['nothing to do']);
  });
});

describe('NEAR top-ups', () => {
  it('top an account back up to its target, from the parent, once it holds less than 90% of it', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    const [buyer1, buyer2] = BUYERS;
    w.chain.accounts.get(buyer1!)!.balance = 45n * MILLINEAR;
    w.chain.accounts.get(buyer2!)!.balance = 45n * MILLINEAR - 1n;
    w.chain.accounts.get(RELAYER)!.balance = 1n * NEAR;
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'transferNear').map(({ signer, receiverId, amount }) => [signer, receiverId, amount])).toEqual([
      [PARENT, RELAYER, 2n * NEAR],
      [PARENT, buyer2, 5n * MILLINEAR + 1n],
    ]);
    expect(w.lines).toEqual([
      `topped up  ${RELAYER}  +2 NEAR  tx ${w.chain.writes[0]?.txHash}`,
      `topped up  ${buyer2}  +0.005000000000000000000001 NEAR  tx ${w.chain.writes[1]?.txHash}`,
    ]);
  });

  it('leave a second run with nothing to send after the first one burnt gas', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    w.chain.txFee = 5n * MILLINEAR;
    await rejection(w.run());
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
    await w.run();
    w.chain.writes = [];
    await w.run();
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("the pools contract's free NEAR", () => {
  /** A world in which setup has run, whose pools contract then holds `balance` and uses `bytes` of storage. */
  async function poolsWorld(balance: bigint, bytes: bigint, config: Partial<SwarmConfig> = {}): Promise<World> {
    const w = await readyWorld({ config });
    const pools = w.chain.accounts.get(POOLS)!;
    pools.balance = balance;
    pools.storageUsage = bytes;
    return w;
  }

  it('is topped up back to QUORUM_POOLS_FREE_NEAR once its storage leaves less than 90% of it free, saying what was free', async () => {
    // 300,000 bytes lock 3 NEAR of the 3.5 NEAR it holds: 0.5 NEAR is free, below 0.9 NEAR.
    const w = await poolsWorld(3_500n * MILLINEAR, 300_000n);
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'transferNear').map(({ signer, receiverId, amount }) => [signer, receiverId, amount])).toEqual([
      [PARENT, POOLS, 500n * MILLINEAR],
    ]);
    expect(w.lines).toEqual([`topped up  ${POOLS}  +0.5 NEAR  0.5 NEAR was free of its storage, now 1 NEAR  tx ${w.chain.writes[0]?.txHash}`]);
    w.chain.writes = [];
    w.lines.length = 0;
    await w.run();
    expect(w.lines).toEqual(['nothing to do']);
  });

  it('is left alone while 90% of QUORUM_POOLS_FREE_NEAR is free, though its balance is below 90% of QUORUM_POOLS_NEAR', async () => {
    // Its code and first records lock 204,022 bytes, 2.04022 NEAR, of 3 NEAR: 0.95978 NEAR is free.
    const w = await poolsWorld(3_000n * MILLINEAR, 204_022n);
    await w.run();
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    expect(w.lines).toEqual(['nothing to do']);
  });

  it('follows QUORUM_POOLS_FREE_NEAR', async () => {
    const w = await poolsWorld(3_500n * MILLINEAR, 204_022n, { poolsFreeNear: 2n * NEAR });
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'transferNear').map(({ receiverId, amount }) => [receiverId, amount])).toEqual([
      [POOLS, 540_220_000_000_000_000_000_000n],
    ]);
  });

  it('counts for nothing while the pools account holds no code: it is topped up to QUORUM_POOLS_NEAR', async () => {
    const w = await poolsWorld(3_000n * MILLINEAR, 0n);
    w.chain.accounts.get(POOLS)!.hasCode = false;
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'transferNear').map(({ receiverId, amount }) => [receiverId, amount])).toEqual([[POOLS, 500n * MILLINEAR]]);
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'deployPools')).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe('runSetup after a run that stopped part way', () => {
  it('creates an account with the key a stopped run left in its key file, and leaves that file as it was', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const buyer5 = BUYERS[4]!;
    w.chain.failWrite((write) => write.kind === 'createAccount' && write.accountId === buyer5, new Error('fetch failed'));
    await expect(w.run()).rejects.toThrow('fetch failed');
    expect(w.chain.accounts.has(buyer5)).toBe(false);
    const left = await readFile(keyFile(w.config, buyer5), 'utf8');
    w.chain.writes = [];
    w.lines.length = 0;
    await rejection(w.run());
    const creations = writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount');
    expect(creations.map((write) => write.accountId)).toEqual(BUYERS.slice(4));
    expect(creations[0]?.publicKeys).toEqual([(JSON.parse(left) as { public_key: string }).public_key]);
    expect(await readFile(keyFile(w.config, buyer5), 'utf8')).toBe(left);
    expect(w.lines.filter((line) => line.includes(keyFile(w.config, buyer5)))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('says, when a write got no result, that setup can be run again once that transaction is final', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const unknown = new OutcomeUnknownError('a transaction from parent to buyer may have been sent, but the RPC gave no result (timeout): it may still run', null, 'timeout');
    w.chain.failWrite((write) => write.kind === 'createAccount' && write.accountId === BUYERS[4], unknown);
    const rejected = await rejection(w.run());
    expect(rejected).toBeInstanceOf(OutcomeUnknownError);
    expect(rejected).toMatchObject({ txHash: null, reason: 'timeout', cause: unknown });
    expect((rejected as Error).message).toBe(
      `${unknown.message}. Setup is idempotent: run it again once that transaction is final, and it sends only what is still missing.`,
    );
  });

  it('creates an account with a new key when a stopped run left its key file empty', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const buyer5 = BUYERS[4]!;
    await mkdir(dirname(keyFile(w.config, buyer5)), { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(keyFile(w.config, buyer5), '');
    await rejection(w.run());
    const [creation] = writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount').filter((write) => write.accountId === buyer5);
    const stored = await readKeyFile(keyFile(w.config, buyer5));
    expect(creation?.publicKeys).toEqual([stored.getPublicKey().toString()]);
  });

  it("completes the relayer's key folder, keeping the keys a stopped run wrote there", async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const folder = keyFolderPath(w.config.credentialsDir, w.config.network, RELAYER);
    const kept = [KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519'), KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519')];
    for (const key of kept) await writeKeyFile(folderKeyPath(folder, key.getPublicKey()), RELAYER, key);
    await rejection(w.run());
    const [relayer] = writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount').filter((write) => write.accountId === RELAYER);
    expect(relayer?.publicKeys).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(relayer?.publicKeys).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(kept.map((key) => key.getPublicKey().toString())));
    const stored = (await readKeyFolder(folder)).map((key) => key.getPublicKey().toString());
    expect(stored.sort()).toEqual([...(relayer?.publicKeys ?? [])].sort());
  });

  it('creates the relayer with the keys a stopped run left, its key file included, and writes no file', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const folder = keyFolderPath(w.config.credentialsDir, w.config.network, RELAYER);
    const kept = Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519'));
    for (const key of kept) await writeKeyFile(folderKeyPath(folder, key.getPublicKey()), RELAYER, key);
    await writeKeyFile(keyFile(w.config, RELAYER), RELAYER, kept[2]!);
    await rejection(w.run());
    const [relayer] = writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount').filter((write) => write.accountId === RELAYER);
    expect([...(relayer?.publicKeys ?? [])].sort()).toEqual(kept.map((key) => key.getPublicKey().toString()).sort());
    expect((await readKeyFile(keyFile(w.config, RELAYER))).getPublicKey().toString()).toBe(kept[2]!.getPublicKey().toString());
    expect(w.lines.filter((line) => line.includes(folder))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('runSetup with accounts that exist', () => {
  it('takes the steps in order: creation, NEAR top-ups, deployment, registrations, token top-ups', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    const last = BUYERS.at(-1)!;
    w.chain.accounts.delete(last);
    w.chain.registered.delete(last);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.delete(last);
    w.chain.accounts.get(POOLS)!.hasCode = false;
    w.chain.accounts.get(RELAYER)!.balance = NEAR;
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, 10_000n);
    await w.run();
    expect(w.chain.writes.map(({ kind, signer }) => [kind, signer])).toEqual([
      ['createAccount', PARENT],
      ['transferNear', PARENT],
      ['deployPools', POOLS],
      ['storageDeposits', PARENT],
      ['ftTransfers', FUNDING],
    ]);
  });

  it('tops a pools account without code up before deploying to it, when it holds less than its code locks', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    // 204,000 bytes lock 2.04 NEAR, more than the 1 NEAR the pools account holds.
    await writeFile(w.config.poolsWasm!, new Uint8Array(204_000));
    Object.assign(w.chain.accounts.get(POOLS)!, { hasCode: false, storageUsage: 0n, balance: NEAR });
    await w.run();
    expect(w.chain.writes.map(({ kind, signer }) => [kind, signer])).toEqual([
      ['transferNear', PARENT],
      ['deployPools', POOLS],
    ]);
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'transferNear')[0]).toMatchObject({ receiverId: POOLS, amount: 2_500n * MILLINEAR });
    expect(await w.chain.account(POOLS)).toEqual({ balance: 3_500n * MILLINEAR, hasCode: true, storageUsage: 204_000n });
    w.chain.writes = [];
    w.lines.length = 0;
    await w.run();
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    expect(w.lines).toEqual(['nothing to do']);
  });

  it('registers only the accounts that are not registered yet', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    w.chain.registered.delete(PROVIDER);
    w.chain.registered.delete(BUYERS[2]!);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, 20_000n);
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'storageDeposits').map((write) => write.accountIds)).toEqual([[PROVIDER, BUYERS[2]]]);
  });

  it('leaves a deployed pools contract with the right token alone, even without its key file', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    await rm(keyFile(w.config, POOLS));
    await w.run();
    expect(w.lines).toEqual(['nothing to do']);
  });

  it('neither creates nor tops up a funding account that is the parent, which signs the token top-ups', async () => {
    const w = await world({ config: { funding: PARENT } });
    w.chain.register(PARENT, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount').map((write) => write.accountId)).not.toContain(PARENT);
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'transferNear')).toEqual([]);
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'ftTransfers').map((write) => write.signer)).toEqual([PARENT, PARENT, PARENT]);
    expect(w.chain.tokenBalances.get(PARENT)).toBe(0n);
  });

  it('uses a funding account outside the parent as it is, topping up only its NEAR', async () => {
    const treasury = 'treasury.testnet';
    const w = await world({ config: { funding: treasury } });
    const { keyPair } = w.chain.addSigner(treasury, 100n * MILLINEAR);
    await writeKeyFile(keyFile(w.config, treasury), treasury, keyPair);
    w.chain.register(treasury, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
    await w.run();
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'createAccount').map((write) => write.accountId)).not.toContain(treasury);
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'transferNear').map(({ signer, receiverId, amount }) => [signer, receiverId, amount])).toEqual([
      [PARENT, treasury, 400n * MILLINEAR],
    ]);
    expect(writesOf(w.chain, 'ftTransfers').map((write) => write.signer)).toEqual([treasury, treasury, treasury]);
  });
});

describe('token top-ups', () => {
  it('read no token balance of an account that does not exist or is not registered: it holds none', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    // A token may refuse the balance of an account it does not know, instead of answering 0.
    const ftBalanceOf = w.chain.ftBalanceOf.bind(w.chain);
    w.chain.ftBalanceOf = async (accountId, atHeight) => {
      if (!w.chain.registered.has(accountId)) throw new Error(`the token does not know ${accountId}`);
      return ftBalanceOf(accountId, atHeight);
    };
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expectSetupError(error, 'token_shortfall', FUNDING);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ account: FUNDING, shortfall: FIRST_RUN_TOKENS });
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
    await w.run();
    expect(w.chain.tokenBalances.get(FUNDING)).toBe(0n);
  });

  it('send each account only what it lacks, and nothing to one that holds its amount or more', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(BUYERS[1]!, 4_000n);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(PROVIDER, 15_000n);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, 6_000n);
    await w.run();
    const transfers = writesOf(w.chain, 'ftTransfers').map((write) => write.transfers);
    expect(transfers).toEqual([[{ receiverId: BUYERS[1], amount: 6_000n }]]);
    expect(w.chain.tokenBalances.get(FUNDING)).toBe(0n);
    expect(w.chain.tokenBalances.get(PROVIDER)).toBe(15_000n);
  });

  it('are none of them made when the funding account cannot cover all, and the spend total is kept', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    await writeSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP, 2_500n);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(BUYERS[1]!, 4_000n);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(MCP, 0n);
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, 15_999n);
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expectSetupError(error, 'token_shortfall', FUNDING);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ account: FUNDING, shortfall: 1n });
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    expect(await readSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP)).toBe(2_500n);
  });
});

describe("the MCP server's spend total", () => {
  it('is cleared even when no account needs tokens', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    await writeSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP, 2_500n);
    await w.run();
    expect(await readSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP)).toBe(0n);
    expect(w.chain.writes).toEqual([]);
    expect(w.lines).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(w.lines[0]).toContain(w.config.spendFile);
  });

  it('replaces the total of another account, left by an earlier QUORUM_MCP_ACCOUNT', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    await writeSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, 'buyer-llm.other.testnet', 2_500n);
    await w.run();
    expect(await readSpendFile(w.config.spendFile, MCP)).toBe(0n);
  });

  it('is never written over a file that is not a spend file', async () => {
    const w = await readyWorld();
    await writeFile(w.config.spendFile, 'not a spend file\n');
    const error = await rejection(w.run());
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(SpendFileError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ problem: 'malformed' });
    expect(await readFile(w.config.spendFile, 'utf8')).toBe('not a spend file\n');
  });
});

describe('what setup prints', () => {
  /** The private key of every key file under `folder`, as `ed25519:<base58>`. */
  async function storedPrivateKeys(folder: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const names = (await readdir(folder, { recursive: true })).filter((name) => name.endsWith('.json'));
    return Promise.all(names.map(async (name) => (await readKeyFile(join(folder, name))).toString()));
  }

  it('never holds a key, in a line or in an error', async () => {
    const w = await world();
    const texts = [((await rejection(w.run())) as Error).message];
    w.chain.tokenBalances.set(FUNDING, FIRST_RUN_TOKENS);
    await w.run();
    w.chain.accounts.get(PARENT)!.balance = 0n;
    w.chain.accounts.get(RELAYER)!.balance = 0n;
    texts.push(((await rejection(w.run())) as Error).message, ...w.lines);
    const keys = await storedPrivateKeys(w.config.credentialsDir);
    expect(keys).toHaveLength(30);
    const printed = texts.join('\n');
    for (const key of keys) expect(printed).not.toContain(key.slice('ed25519:'.length));
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { createPrivateKey, createPublicKey } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdtemp, readFile, rm, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { parseEnv } from 'node:util';
import { folderKeyPath, KeyFileError, keyFolderPath, writeKeyFile } from '@quorum-on-near/buyer';
import { KeyPair } from 'near-api-js';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
// The apps' own loaders, from their sources: the swarm itself never imports another app.
import { loadConfig, type GatewayConfig } from '../../gateway/src/config.ts';
import { loadSwarmConfig, type SwarmConfig } from '../src/config.ts';
import {
  aclNotice,
  EnvFileExistsError,
  envFilePath,
  gatewayEnvText,
  newCredentialJwk,
  writeEnvFile,
  writeGatewayEnv,
} from '../src/env-files.ts';

const RELAYER = 'gas.test.near';

let dir: string;

beforeEach(async () => {
  dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'quorum-env-files-'));
});

afterEach(async () => {
  await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

/** A swarm configuration in which no shared value is the apps' default, with its files in the temp folder. */
function sandboxConfig(overrides: Partial<SwarmConfig> = {}): SwarmConfig {
  return {
    ...loadSwarmConfig({
      QUORUM_NETWORK: 'near:sandbox',
      QUORUM_RPC_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:3030',
      QUORUM_GATEWAY_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:9000',
      QUORUM_PARENT_ACCOUNT: 'test.near',
      QUORUM_TOKEN_ACCOUNT: 'musd.test.near',
      QUORUM_POOLS_ACCOUNT: 'escrow.test.near',
      QUORUM_BLOCK_TIME_MS: '600',
      QUORUM_RELAYER_ACCOUNT: RELAYER,
      QUORUM_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT: 'seller.test.near',
      QUORUM_MCP_ACCOUNT: 'agent.test.near',
      QUORUM_COMMIT_MIN_GAS: '40000000000000',
      QUORUM_COMMIT_MAX_GAS: '60000000000000',
      QUORUM_BUYER_BUDGET: '20000',
      QUORUM_CREDENTIALS_DIR: join(dir, 'keys'),
      QUORUM_MCP_SPEND_FILE: join(dir, 'spend.json'),
      QUORUM_BUYER_MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: '90',
    }),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** The error `promise` rejects with; fails the test if it resolves. */
async function rejection(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
  try {
    await promise;
  } catch (error) {
    return error;
  }
  throw new Error('the promise resolved');
}

/** Writes `count` new keys to the relayer's key folder and returns them. */
async function relayerKeys(config: SwarmConfig, count: number): Promise<KeyPair[]> {
  const folder = keyFolderPath(config.credentialsDir, config.network, config.relayer);
  const keys = Array.from({ length: count }, () => KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519'));
  for (const key of keys) await writeKeyFile(folderKeyPath(folder, key.getPublicKey()), config.relayer, key);
  return keys;
}

describe('gatewayEnvText', () => {
  it("is read by the gateway's own loader as the swarm is configured, with every relayer key and the credential key", () => {
    const keys = [KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519'), KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519'), KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519')];
    const jwk = newCredentialJwk();
    const gateway = loadConfig(parseEnv(gatewayEnvText(sandboxConfig(), keys, jwk)));
    expect(gateway).toMatchObject<Partial<GatewayConfig>>({
      network: 'near:sandbox',
      rpcUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:3030',
      publicUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:9000',
      parent: 'test.near',
      token: 'musd.test.near',
      poolsContract: 'escrow.test.near',
      relayer: RELAYER,
      provider: 'seller.test.near',
      relayerKeys: keys.map((key) => key.toString()),
      credentialJwk: { ...jwk },
      minGas: 40_000_000_000_000n,
      maxGas: 60_000_000_000_000n,
      blockTimeMs: 600,
    });
  });

  it('sets only the variables the gateway shares with the swarm, and its two secrets', () => {
    const text = gatewayEnvText(sandboxConfig(), [KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519')], newCredentialJwk());
    expect(Object.keys(parseEnv(text)).sort()).toEqual([
      'QUORUM_BLOCK_TIME_MS',
      'QUORUM_COMMIT_MAX_GAS',
      'QUORUM_COMMIT_MIN_GAS',
      'QUORUM_CREDENTIAL_JWK',
      'QUORUM_GATEWAY_URL',
      'QUORUM_NETWORK',
      'QUORUM_PARENT_ACCOUNT',
      'QUORUM_POOLS_ACCOUNT',
      'QUORUM_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT',
      'QUORUM_RELAYER_ACCOUNT',
      'QUORUM_RELAYER_KEYS',
      'QUORUM_RPC_URL',
      'QUORUM_TOKEN_ACCOUNT',
    ]);
  });

  it('refuses a value that would not read back as it is, naming the variable and not the value', () => {
    const config = sandboxConfig({ rpcUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:3030/#fragment' });
    expect(() => gatewayEnvText(config, [KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519')], newCredentialJwk())).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => gatewayEnvText(config, [KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519')], newCredentialJwk())).toThrow(/QUORUM_RPC_URL/);
    expect(() => gatewayEnvText(config, [KeyPair.fromRandom('ed25519')], newCredentialJwk())).not.toThrow(/fragment/);
  });

  it('needs at least one relayer key', () => {
    expect(() => gatewayEnvText(sandboxConfig(), [], newCredentialJwk())).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});

describe('newCredentialJwk', () => {
  it('is a private Ed25519 JWK with only kty, crv, x and d, where x is the public key of d', () => {
    const jwk = newCredentialJwk();
    expect(Object.keys(jwk).sort()).toEqual(['crv', 'd', 'kty', 'x']);
    expect([jwk.kty, jwk.crv]).toEqual(['OKP', 'Ed25519']);
    expect(createPublicKey(createPrivateKey({ key: { ...jwk }, format: 'jwk' })).export({ format: 'jwk' }).x).toBe(jwk.x);
  });

  it('is a new key each time', () => {
    expect(newCredentialJwk().d).not.toBe(newCredentialJwk().d);
  });
});

describe('aclNotice', () => {
  it('on Windows, says the file is protected only by its folder’s access list, and gives the icacls command for the user', () => {
    const path = 'C:\\repo with space\\apps\\gateway\\.env';
    expect(aclNotice(path, 'win32', 'Ada Lovelace')).toBe(
      `${path} is protected only by its folder's access control list, since Windows ignores the file mode: ` +
        `to let Ada Lovelace alone use it, run icacls "${path}" /inheritance:r /grant:r "Ada Lovelace:F"`,
    );
  });

  it.each(['linux', 'darwin'] as const)('is null on %s, where the file is created readable by its owner only', (platform) => {
    expect(aclNotice('/repo/apps/gateway/.env', platform, 'ada')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('writeGatewayEnv', () => {
  it("writes every key of the relayer's key folder and a new credential key, as the gateway reads them", async () => {
    const config = sandboxConfig();
    const keys = await relayerKeys(config, 3);
    const path = join(dir, 'gateway.env');
    await writeGatewayEnv(config, path);
    const gateway = loadConfig(parseEnv(await readFile(path, 'utf8')));
    expect([...gateway.relayerKeys].sort()).toEqual(keys.map((key) => key.toString()).sort());
    expect(gateway.relayer).toBe(RELAYER);
  });

  it('gives each file it writes a credential key of its own', async () => {
    const config = sandboxConfig();
    await relayerKeys(config, 1);
    await writeGatewayEnv(config, join(dir, 'first.env'));
    await writeGatewayEnv(config, join(dir, 'second.env'));
    const jwk = async (name: string): Promise<string | undefined> =>
      parseEnv(await readFile(join(dir, name), 'utf8')).QUORUM_CREDENTIAL_JWK;
    expect(await jwk('first.env')).not.toBe(await jwk('second.env'));
  });

  it('refuses to write over a file that exists', async () => {
    const config = sandboxConfig();
    await relayerKeys(config, 1);
    const path = join(dir, 'gateway.env');
    await writeFile(path, 'KEPT=1\n');
    expect(await rejection(writeGatewayEnv(config, path))).toBeInstanceOf(EnvFileExistsError);
    expect(await readFile(path, 'utf8')).toBe('KEPT=1\n');
  });

  it("fails without the relayer's key folder, which setup writes", async () => {
    const error = await rejection(writeGatewayEnv(sandboxConfig(), join(dir, 'gateway.env')));
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(KeyFileError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ problem: 'missing' });
  });
});
```
